data.judul: ANGKUTAN LAUT DALAM NEGERI LINER DAN TRAMPER UNTUK
data.uraian:
PENUMPANG
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas transportasi penumpang melalui
laut dengan menggunakan kapal laut antarpelabuhan dalam negeri,
baik melalui pelayanan angkutan laut yang dilakukan dengan trayek
secara tetap dan teratur (liner) dengan berjadwal dan menyebutkan
pelabuhan singgah, maupun trayek tidak tetap dan tidak teratur
(tramper), termasuk kegiatan kapal penumpang yang dioperasikan
pemerintah atau swasta lainnya, serta kegiatan penyewaan angkutan
laut berikut operatornya.
Kelompok ini juga mencakup
- angkutan laut dalam negeri pelayaran rakyat untuk penumpang
yang menggunakan kapal layar, kapal motor tradisional, dan kapal
layar motor dengan ukuran tertentu.

persyaratan: Menempati tempat usaha, baik berupa milik sendiri maupun sewa, berdasarkan surat keterangan domisili perusahaan atau koperasi dari instansi yang berwenang

Memiliki paling sedikit 1 (satu) orang tenaga ahli setingkat diploma iii di bidang ketatalaksanaan, nautis, atau teknis pelayaran niaga, yang dibuktikan dengan salinan ijazah yang dilegalisir oleh instansi yang berwenang dan surat pengangkatan sebagai karyawan atau perjanjian/kon trak kerja
Memiliki rencana usaha dan rencana pengoperasian kapal (bussines plan)
Memiliki Kapal berbendera indonesia yang laik laut dengan ukuran paling kecil gt 175 (seratus tujuh puluh lima gross tonnage)
Bagi perusahaan patungan (joint venture) memiliki kapal motor berbendera indonesia yang laik laut paling sedikit 1 (satu) unit dengan ukuran paling kecil gt
000 (lima ribu gross tonnage) dan diawaki oleh awak kapal berkewarganegara -an indonesia

Memiliki kapal tunda berbendera indonesia yang laik laut paling sedikit 1 (satu) unit dengan daya motor penggerak paling kecil 150 (seratus lima puluh) tenaga kuda (tk) dengan paling sedikit 1 (satu) unit tongkang berukuran paling kecil gt 175 (seratus tujuh puluh lima gross tonnage)
Memiliki kapal tunda berbendera indonesia yang laik laut paling sedikit 1 (satu) unit dengan ukuran paling kecil gt 175 (seratus tujuh puluh lima gross tonnage) atau
Memiliki tongkang bermesin berbendera indonesia yang laik laut paling sedikit 1 (satu) unit dengan ukuran paling kecil gt 175 (seratus tujuh puluh lima gross tonnage).
Tongkang bermesin sebagaimana dimaksud pada butir 3 merupakan tongkang yang memiliki mesin penggerak sendiri

Kepemilikan kapal berbendera indonesia yang laik laut harus dapat dibuktikan melalui: a. Grosse akta kapal b. Surat ukur kapal yang masih berlaku c. Sertifikat keselamata n kapal yang masih berlaku dan d. Crew list bagi tongkang bermesin

Melaporkan kepada pejabat pemberi izin setiap pembukaan kantor cabang perusahaan angkutan laut

Menyampaikan laporan kunjungan kapal kepada penyelenggara pelabuhan yang merupakan realisasi dari laporan rencana kedatangan dan keberangkatan kapal
Melaporkan realisasi pengoperasian kapal (voyage report) kepada pejabat pemberi izin yang merupakan rekapitulasi dari laporan kunjungan kapal

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Domestic maritime tourism transport — operating boats and vessels for tourist excursions, island-hopping cruises, diving charter trips, and leisure sea transport within Indonesian waters. This covers tourist-focused water transport, not regular passenger ferry services.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Medium / Large scale**: Medium-High risk. NIB + Standard Certificate — issued within 14 working days.


**PMA:** Fully open to PMA — 100% foreign ownership allowed.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Unchanged from KBLI 2020 — direct match.
intel_2026.baliContext: This is the key code for diving charters, day trips to Nusa Penida, snorkeling boats to Menjangan Island, and sunset cruises departing from Sanur, Serangan, Padangbai, and Benoa Marina. KSOP (Kantor Syahbandar dan Otoritas Pelabuhan) licensing is required — separate from OSS — for vessel operation permits. All vessels must have valid class certificates from BKI (Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia). Crew must hold STCW certification.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- KSOP vessel operation permit — separate mandatory licensing
- 79110 — Travel agency if you also sell tour packages
- 93292 — Diving activities (underwater sport services)
intel_2026.zantaraOpener: Tourist boat operations in Bali — dive charters, Nusa Penida day trips, cruises? Let me explain KSOP vessel licensing and how to set up a compliant maritime tourism business.

Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas penyimpanan yang meliputi
kegiatan penerimaan, pengumpulan, penampungan dan pengeluaran
minyak bumi, bahan bakar minyak, bahan bakar gas, dan/atau hasil
olahan pada lokasi di atas dan/atau di bawah permukaan tanah
dan/atau permukaan air.
Kelompok ini juga mencakup
- pengoperasian penyimpanan minyak dan gas bumi di zona
perdagangan bebas;
- aktivitas penyimpanan bahan bakar tanpa karbon sebagai
pembawa energi (hidrogen, amonia, dan senyawa lainnya), baik
dalam bentuk formasi geologis, kompresi gas, bentuk padatan,
bentuk cairan, maupun bentuk lainnya;
- pengoperasian gudang dingin untuk penyimpanan minyak dan gas
bumi;
- pengoperasian penyimpanan minyak dan gas bumi dengan sistem
resi gudang;
- pengoperasian tempat penyimpanan fisik komoditas minyak dan
gas bumi.

lain;

melalui sistem elektronik (PMSE);

dalam bentuk cair dan gas, seperti air dan gas yang dicairkan
- pengoperasian tempat penyimpanan komoditas fisik yang tidak
diklasifikasikan ditempat lain.

counter).

data.judul: PELAYANAN PENUMPANG, BAGASI, KARGO, POS, DAN TEKNIS
data.uraian:
PENANGANAN UDARA DI DARAT
Kelompok ini mencakup
- pelayanan teknis dan operasional untuk mendukung operasional
pesawat udara di darat untuk penumpang dan kargo (ground
handling), termasuk pengisian bahan bakar, pengisian air,
penanganan limbah, serta pemindahan pesawat;
- pelayanan penumpang di bandara, seperti proses check -in,
boarding, dan transit;
- penanganan bagasi, kargo, dan pos, baik untuk proses muat
maupun bongkar;
- pemeriksaan barang muatan dalam kargo dan/atau peti kemas
dengan menggunakan sumber radiasi pengion (zat radioaktif dan
pembangkit radiasi pengion).
Kelompok ini juga mencakup
- layanan dokumentasi, penimbangan, pengamanan, serta
penanganan khusus terhadap barang berbahaya atau bernilai
tinggi.

Dokumen program proteksi dan keselamatan radiasi
Dokumen program keamanan zat radioaktif
Dokumen bukti kepemilikan dan/atau penguasaan sumber radiasi pengion
Dokumen sistem manajemen
Dokumen program perawatan

data.uraian:
MUATAN PENERBANGAN
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas pemeriksaan danpengendalian
keamanan penerbangan terhadap kargo atau pos yang akan diangkut
menggunakan pesawat udara,termasuk pesawat udara tanpa awak
(drone),untuk memenuhi standar keamanan penerbangan nasional
dan internasional, sebagai bagian dari sistem keamanan rantai pasok
udara. Aktivitas ini biasanya dilakukan entitas yang bergerak di
bidang keagenan kargo atau pengiriman.
Kelompok ini juga mencakup
- aktivitas pemeriksaan keamanan kargo atau pos menggunakan
metode yang telah disetujui seperti sumber radiasi pengion (zat
radioaktif dan pembangkit radiasi pengion), explosive trace
detection (ETD), atau prosedur keamanan internal lainnya,
sebelum barang diserahkan ke maskapai;
- aktivitas pengendalian akses ke area terbatas, pengawasan
terhadap pergerakan barang, pengendalian kendaraan
pengangkut, serta pengawasan proses penyerahan barang kepada
maskapai penerbangan.
Kelompok ini tidak mencakup
- pemeriksaan dan pengendalian keamanan muatan penerbangan

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Five-star hotels — the top tier of Indonesian hotel classification. Full-service luxury accommodation with daily or weekly stays in a dedicated building. Think Four Seasons, Ritz-Carlton, Bulgari-level operations. Rooms, suites, restaurants, pools, spas, concierge — the works.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Small / Medium / Large**: Two licensing tiers exist.
- **Medium-Low risk path**: NIB + Standard Certificate, issued **automatically**. Self-Assessment document required covering facilities, organization, HR, and products/services. Health Feasibility Certificate needed.
- **Medium-High risk path** (higher tier): NIB + Standard Certificate within **14 working days**. Requires Self-Assessment plus LSPr-certified tourism business standard.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Two-Star Hotels — commercial accommodation businesses that rent out furnished rooms or suites on a short-term basis. This classification covers entire or partial buildings equipped with dedicated front desk customer service, daily housekeeping, and food/beverage services. It strictly applies to standardized hotel operations and excludes standard residential villas or unclassified homestays.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
PP28 data inherited from parent code 55110. Three distinct licensing tiers exist:

**Tier 1 — Kecil/Menengah/Besar**: Medium-Low risk (Menengah Rendah). NIB + Standard Certificate issued **automatically** (Otomatis). Self-Assessment document covering Hotel Star standards (Sarana, Organisasi, SDM, Pelayanan, Produk, Manajemen). Health Feasibility Certificate required. Authority: Bupati/Walikota.

**Tier 2 — Kecil/Menengah/Besar**: Medium-High risk (Menengah Tinggi). NIB + Standard Certificate within **14 days**. Self-Assessment required. Must obtain LSPr-certified Tourism Business Standard. Health Feasibility Certificate. TKA documentation required if employing foreign workers. Authority: Gubernur.

**Tier 3 — Mikro/Kecil**: Medium-High risk (Menengah Tinggi). NIB + Standard Certificate within **14 days**. Same LSPr certification and Health Certificate requirements. Authority: Gubernur.

**Important:** Even Mikro-scale hotels carry Medium-High risk under Tier 3 — there is NO low-risk path for any hotel operation regardless of size.

**Post-issuance obligations across all tiers:**
- Obtain a Health Feasibility Certificate (Sertifikat Laik Sehat)
- Obtain an Alcohol Direct Sales Certificate (SKPL A, B, or C) if serving alcohol
- Submit Self-Assessment Document (Dokumen Penilaian Mandiri Kesiapan Penerapan Standar usaha Hotel Bintang)

**PMA Status:** Fully open (Terbuka) — 100% foreign ownership.

**Source Regulation:** PP 28/2025, Perpres 10/2021, 49/2021, 14/2024.
intel_2026.whatChanged: CODICE_RINUMERATO. This code has been renumbered and split from the older KBLI 2020 code 55110 (Hotel Bintang) to specifically isolate two-star hotel classifications.
intel_2026.baliContext: Two-star hotels in Bali frequently take the shape of premium surf camps, digital nomad lodges, or boutique budget stays in hotspots like Batu Bolong, Padang Padang, and central Ubud. Setting up a formal hotel requires robust zoning compliance; your land must be located in a commercial or tourism zone (Kawasan Pariwisata). Unlike a simple villa, a two-star hotel involves 24/7 operational overheads, staff facilities, and heavy scrutiny over commercial building permits (PBG). Expect construction costs for a typical 20-room lodge in a secondary location to start around IDR 5-8 billion, plus a hefty land lease (Hak Sewa) running IDR 15-25 million per are per year. Navigating local banjar relations is essential if you plan to secure an alcohol permit (SKPL) for your pool bar.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 56101 — Restaurants (for your on-site dining venue)
- 56301 — Bars (if you operate a dedicated alcohol-serving venue)
- 77100 — Vehicle Rental (if you rent scooters to guests)
- 96230 — Spa/Sauna (if you offer on-site spa facilities)

- Submit a Self-Assessment Document for Hotel Standards (Dokumen Penilaian Mandiri Kesiapan Penerapan Standar usaha Hotel Bintang)

intel_2026.baliContext: In the Bali ecosystem, a one-star hotel is often the legal classification used for high-end backpacker hostels, upscale guesthouses, or 'kos-kosan elit' (elite boarding houses) that transition into daily tourist rentals. It is a highly profitable, high-turnover model in dense areas like Legian, Tuban, and central Denpasar. While cheaper to build than a 2-star property, it still requires formal LSPr (Tourism Certification Body) audits. A common trap for foreign investors is treating this like a small homestay; the OSS system views it as a formal commercial hotel, meaning your environmental documents (SPPL/UKL-UPL) and wastewater management (IPAL) will be strictly monitored by the local environmental agency (DLHK).

The banjar (village council) system means your neighbors know if you're hosting guests — and community approval matters as much as government licensing. Ubud pioneered the homestay movement. Munduk, Sidemen, Amed, and Pemuteran have growing homestay scenes catering to the 'authentic Bali' crowd. Keep in mind: Bali's awig-awig (customary village rules) can impose additional conditions — some banjars require a contribution or approval before you can host tourists. Also, your building must genuinely be a residence where the owner lives, not a converted villa pretending to be a homestay.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Villas — private houses exclusively rented out to tourists, with facilities, managed by the owner. Unlike a homestay (55201), the owner does not live on the same property. These are dedicated short-stay rental properties: the classic Bali villa experience with a private pool, tropical garden, and often resident staff. One villa or an entire compound — this is the code.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Micro + Small + Medium**: Medium-Low risk (Menengah Rendah). NIB + Sertifikat Standar issued **automatically** via OSS (Otomatis).

**Step-by-step to operate legally:**
1. **PT PMA incorporation** — notary deed, AHU registration, TDP (~2–4 weeks, IDR 8–15M notary fees)
2. **NIB via OSS** — register on oss.go.id, select 55203, auto-issued (1–3 days)
3. **Sertifikat Standar** — auto-issued with NIB for Menengah Rendah
4. **KKPR** (Kesesuaian Kegiatan Pemanfaatan Ruang) — spatial conformity, from ATR/BPN (2–6 weeks, if land zoning requires it)
5. **PBG** (Persetujuan Bangunan Gedung) — building permit, replaces IMB since 2022 (4–12 weeks)
6. **Sertifikat Laik Sehat** — health feasibility certificate from Dinas Kesehatan (2–4 weeks)
7. **Tanda Daftar Usaha Pariwisata (TDUP)** — tourism business registration from Dinas Pariwisata Kabupaten

**Typical total timeline:** 3–5 months from PT PMA to fully operational.
**Minimum PT PMA capital:** IDR 10 billion stated capital (Rp 2.5B paid-up).

**Authority:** Bupati/Walikota (district/city level).
**PMA:** Fully open — 100% foreign ownership. No local partner required.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Renumbered from 55193 in KBLI 2020 to 55203 in 2025 (CODICE_RINUMERATO). PP28 licensing data maps from old code 55193 with a 100% match — same risk level, same permits, same obligations. No substantive change for operators: if you are running under 55193, the transition to 55203 is administrative only.
intel_2026.zantaraOpener: Running a villa in Bali? 55203 is the most popular accommodation code among foreign investors — and also the most regulated. Let me walk you through exactly what you need, the real costs, and the traps to avoid.
intel_2026.baliContext:
**🏝 The Bali Villa Market (Reality Check)**
- Villas ARE Bali's tourism identity: Seminyak, Canggu, Ubud, Uluwatu, Sanur — every area has its scene
- Most popular accommodation KBLI for foreign investors by volume
- Typical structure: PT PMA leases land (Hak Sewa, 25–30 years), builds villa, rents on Airbnb/Booking.com
- **Oversupply warning:** Canggu and Seminyak have thousands of villas competing for the same guests; occupancy rates have dropped significantly since 2022
- **Better ROI areas (2025):** Tabanan, Sidemen (Karangasem), Amed, north coast — lower land prices, growing demand

**💸 Real Costs to Budget**
- Land lease (Hak Sewa, 25 years, Canggu): IDR 1.5–4B per are (100m²)
- Villa construction (mid-range): IDR 8–15M per m²
- PT PMA setup (notary + legal): IDR 8–15M
- TDUP + permits + PBG: IDR 5–15M total
- Monthly operational (staff, maintenance, pool, gardener): IDR 15–40M depending on size

**⚠ Common Mistakes That Kill the Business**
- **Operating without TDUP** — Dinas Pariwisata enforcement intensified in 2023–2024; fines and closure orders have been executed in Canggu, Pererenan, and Seminyak
- **Building before PBG** — IMB/PBG crackdowns since 2024 have resulted in actual demolition orders in Bali
- **Skipping Sertifikat Laik Sehat** — required for legal operation; without it your NIB is valid but your villa is not
- **Ignoring the banjar** — local village council approval is not a government permit but is socially and operationally essential; no banjar consent = neighbor problems, access issues, staff walkouts
- **Nominee land ownership** — still common, still illegal; BPN and PPATK have increased scrutiny on nominee arrangements since 2023
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- **56101** — If you provide food service (in-villa chef, breakfast, restaurant)
- **68112** — For the property lease/rental structure (if your PT PMA also holds the lease)
- **96230** — If you offer spa or massage services at the villa
- **79110** — If you arrange tours, activities, or transfers for guests
- **77311** — If you rent out motorbikes, scooters, or vehicles to guests
- **41012** — If your PT PMA also builds/constructs the villa itself

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Serviced apartments — apartments managed and operated as hotels for short-term stays, with payment calculated per-night or per-period. Think aparthotel (apartel) or condotel (kondotel). The unit is an apartment by design, but it functions as a hotel room: housekeeping, front desk, daily rates. This is *not* a long-term residential lease — it's hospitality accommodation in apartment form.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Micro + Small**: Medium-High risk (Menengah Tinggi). NIB + Sertifikat Standar, but requires a **Self-Assessment Readiness Document** (Dokumen Penilaian Mandiri Kesiapan Penerapan Standar). Processing: 14 days (Jangka Waktu: 14 Hari).

Post-issuance obligations:
- Obtain a Health Feasibility Certificate (Sertifikat Laik Sehat)
- Obtain a tourism business standard certificate from an accredited LSPr (Sertifikat Standar Usaha Pariwisata dari Lembaga Sertifikasi Profesi)

**Authority:** Governor (Gubernur) — provincial level, not Bupati/Walikota. This signals a higher regulatory bar than villas or homestays.

**PMA:** Fully open (Terbuka) — 100% foreign ownership.

Note: Renumbered from old code 55194 (Apartemen Hotel), same licensing substance.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Renumbered from 55194 in KBLI 2020 to 55204 in 2025 (CODICE_RINUMERATO). The PP28 licensing data comes from the old 55194 entry with a perfect 100% match. Same business, new code number. The key difference from villas (55203): aparthotels carry **Medium-High** risk, require Governor-level approval, and need LSPr certification — villas are Medium-Low with automatic issuance.
intel_2026.baliContext: Aparthotels are growing fast in Bali, especially in Seminyak, Kuta, and the Canggu-Berawa corridor. The model is popular with developers: build apartment units, sell them to individual investors, then manage the entire building as a hotel — the owner gets rental income, the operator runs it like a hotel. Condotels in Bali have been controversial (many buyers felt misled about returns), but the model persists because it works for both parties when managed well. Regulatory scrutiny is increasing — the Governor-level licensing reflects this. Occupancy can be excellent in prime locations (70-85% in peak season), but the per-night rate is typically lower than equivalent star-rated hotels. The sweet spot is lifestyle travelers who want a kitchen, washing machine, and living space but still want hotel services. Canggu and Uluwatu are seeing the newest developments in this category.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 56101 — Restaurant or food service (if you offer breakfast/dining)
- 55101-55106 — If any units are classified as star-rated hotel rooms
- 68112 — For the underlying property lease/rental structure
- 96230 — If you offer spa or wellness services
- 93116 — If you include gym/fitness facilities
- 55400 — If you list on OTAs (accommodation intermediary activity)

intel_2026.whatItMeans: This is your classic restaurant code — any place that serves food in a permanent building. Sit-down restaurants, warungs with concrete walls, fast food joints, food courts inside malls, even hotel restaurants. If people walk in, sit down, and eat food you cooked in a fixed building, this is the code.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Micro scale** (smallest operations): Medium-Low risk. You get your NIB + Standard Certificate automatically — no waiting. You'll need a Hygiene Sanitation Label (HSP) and must submit periodic activity reports.

**Small / Medium / Large scale**: Medium-High risk. NIB + Standard Certificate issued within **14 working days**. You'll need a Self-Assessment of Standard Readiness, a certified standard from an LSPr (certification body), and a Hygiene Sanitation Feasibility Certificate (SLHS).

**PMA (foreign investment):** Fully open — 100% foreign ownership allowed.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Big change in 2025. The old 56101 (restaurants) got merged with three other codes: 56103 (food stalls/tents), 56104 (self-service restaurants), and 56109 (other fixed-building food). So if you had a cafeteria-style or self-service setup under a separate code before, it's all 56101 now. One code to rule them all for fixed-building food service.
intel_2026.baliContext: This is the single most common business code for foreigners in Bali. Seminyak, Canggu, and Ubud are saturated — the competition is fierce and landlords know it. Sanur and Uluwatu still have room. Keep in mind: Bali's health department (Dinas Kesehatan) does actual inspections for your SLHS, and they check kitchen hygiene, water quality, and food storage. Budget 2-4 weeks for the inspection alone. Also, most Bali restaurants need a separate liquor license if they serve alcohol — 56101 alone doesn't cover that.

- 56303 — If you also operate as a café/coffee shop
- 47221 — If you sell retail beverages (bottled drinks to go)
- 68112 — If you're leasing the building yourself

You cook it, you bring it there, you serve it. This is a contract-based food service, not a walk-in restaurant.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Micro + Small scale**: Medium-Low risk. NIB + Standard Certificate issued **automatically**. You need a Hygiene Sanitation Label (HSP) and periodic reports.

**Medium + Large scale**: Medium-High risk. NIB + Standard Certificate within **14 working days**. Requires Self-Assessment of Standard Readiness, LSPr-certified tourism business standard, and Hygiene Sanitation Feasibility Certificate (SLHS).

**PMA:** Fully open — 100% foreign ownership.
intel_2026.whatChanged: No change — direct match from KBLI 2020 (MATCH_LANGSUNG). Event catering stays event catering.
intel_2026.baliContext: Bali's wedding industry is enormous — Uluwatu cliffs, Ubud rice terraces, beachfront venues in Nusa Dua. Catering for destination weddings is a serious business here. Many villa rental companies look for reliable catering partners. If you're scaling up to Medium/Large, the LSPr certification process takes 1-3 months and costs IDR 5-15 million depending on the certification body. Pro tip: partner with existing venues rather than competing — most high-end venues in Bali have preferred caterer lists.

Covers: food contractors for transport companies, long-term catering at oil drilling sites/mines/hospitals/transport; sports facility/cafeteria catering on concession basis (factories, offices, hospitals, schools); household catering; nutritious meal provision and distribution; cloud kitchen contractor services. intel_2026.whatYouNeed:

**PMA:** Fully open — 100% foreign ownership allowed.
intel_2026.whatChanged: MATCH_LANGSUNG — unchanged from KBLI 2020. Same code, same scope.
intel_2026.baliContext: B2B catering is a stable, unglamorous business in Bali. Hotels outsource banquet catering, tech coworking spaces need daily lunch programs, international schools contract meal providers. Cloud kitchen operations for food delivery apps also fall here. Less location-sensitive than consumer venues — can operate from industrial/mixed zones. Lower community friction (no noise, no tourist crowds). For PMA investors, the IDR 10B minimum makes this viable only at scale — think corporate catering serving 5+ clients, not a single kitchen.

- 56210 — Event Catering (for one-off event services)
- 10750 — Prepared Meals Manufacturing (if producing packaged meals)

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Bars — places where the main business is serving drinks, both alcoholic (spirits, beer, wine, whisky) and non-alcoholic. This includes beach clubs where drinks are the primary offering, bars on trains or boats, and any establishment where beverages are the star and food is secondary.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Medium + Large scale only** (no Micro/Small entries): Medium-High risk. NIB + Standard Certificate within **14 working days**. You need a Self-Assessment of Standard Readiness document, LSPr-certified standard, and a Health Feasibility Certificate (Sertifikat Laik Sehat).

**PMA:** Fully open — 100% foreign ownership.

Note: There's no Micro/Small scale licensing path in the data. Bars are regulated at Medium scale and above.

intel_2026.baliContext: Bali's bar and beach club scene is legendary — Seminyak's Jl. Petitenget, Canggu's Batu Bolong, Uluwatu's cliff-top venues. The key wrinkle: you need a separate alcohol distribution license (SIUP-MB) on top of this KBLI code. The alcohol license comes from the provincial trade office and can take 2-6 months. Beach clubs like Potato Head, Finns, and La Brisa all operate under this code. Important: Bali has periodic alcohol restriction discussions around Nyepi and religious holidays — stay informed about local regulations. Also, noise complaints from banjar (village councils) can shut you down faster than any government agency.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Night clubs — establishments primarily serving beverages alongside dance facilities, live music, and light shows. Includes hostesses/attendants for VIP service and entertainment acts. This is NOT just a bar with music — it's a specifically defined nightlife category with spettacoli (shows) and operational reality checks.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Medium/Large scale ONLY** (no Micro/Small). Medium-High risk. NIB + Standard Certificate verified within **14 days**. Must obtain LSPr certification and Sertifikat Laik Sehat.

**CRITICAL:** Requires SKPL-A (or B and C) alcohol license — subject to strict regional quotas. Authority: Governor (not local Bupati).

**PMA:** Fully open — 100% foreign ownership allowed.
intel_2026.whatChanged: MATCH_LANGSUNG — code unchanged, but enforcement has dramatically intensified since 2024.
intel_2026.baliContext: THIS IS THE MOST DANGEROUS CODE IN BALI. Satpol PP (Public Order Enforcement) now classifies venues by operational reality, not license text. If you have a DJ booth, dance floor, and ticketed entry, you ARE 56302 regardless of what your NIB says. CRITICAL ZONING: 56302 is PROHIBITED in Yellow (Residential) and Green (Agricultural) zones. Requires specific Tourism/Entertainment Zoning. Many Canggu venues operated as 'restaurants' (56101) or 'bars' while functioning as nightclubs — these face immediate closure when audited. The SKPL alcohol license is a scarce, quota-controlled asset in saturated areas like Seminyak. Noise regulations (decibel limits) are now actively enforced with professional measurement equipment.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 56301 — Bar (safer alternative if no dance floor)
- 56101 — Restaurant (if also serving food)
- 93291 — Dance Venue (for dedicated dance events)
- 56305 — Herbal/Jamu Shop (NOT a bar — see note)
intel_2026.zantaraOpener: Opening a nightclub in Bali? 56302 is the highest-risk F&B code — zoning violations can get you sealed overnight.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Discotheques — pure dance music venues focused on DJ performances, electronic music, and clubbing experiences. Unlike night clubs (56302) which feature live shows and spettacoli, discotheques focus on recorded music, DJ sets, and dance floor atmosphere without structured entertainment acts.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**All scales (Micro through Large)**: Medium-Low risk. NIB + Standard Certificate issued **automatically** — no waiting period for any scale. PMA businesses need an LSPr-certified standard. You'll need a Self-Assessment document covering facilities, organization, and HR.

**PMA:** Fully open — 100% foreign ownership.

intel_2026.baliContext: Bali's discotheque scene centers on DJ culture and electronic music venues. Unlike night clubs with live shows, discotheques focus on pure dance floor experiences with professional sound systems and lighting. The good news: 56303 is one of the easier F&B codes to get — Medium-Low risk at ALL scales, automatic issuance. The bad news: exactly because it's easy, competition is brutal. Ubud's Jl. Goutama, Canggu's Pantai Berawa, and Seminyak's backstreets are all oversaturated. Consider emerging areas like Amed, Sidemen, or Tabanan if you want breathing room. Technical infrastructure (DJ booths, sound systems, lighting) is critical — budget accordingly for your Technical Manager.

- 56301 — If you serve alcohol
- 47221 — If you sell packaged retail beverages
- 93291 — If you host special DJ events or performances

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Karaoke establishments — venues providing private or public karaoke rooms with audio/video equipment for singing entertainment. Includes beverage service and light snacks as part of the karaoke experience. Popular for group entertainment and social gatherings.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Micro, Small**: Medium-Low risk (Menengah Rendah). NIB and Standard Certificate (Sertifikat Standar) are issued **automatically** (Otomatis).

**Post-issuance obligations:**
- Obtain a Food Hygiene and Sanitation Label (Label Higiene Sanitasi Pangan / HSP)
- Submit periodic activity reports (Laporan kegiatan secara berkala)
- Submit standards compliance documentation (Menyampaikan dokumen penerapan standar)

**Authority:** Regent/Mayor (Bupati/Walikota).

**PMA Status:** Fully open (Terbuka) — 100% foreign ownership.

**Source Regulation:** PP 28/2025, Perpres 10/2021, 49/2021, 14/2024.
intel_2026.whatChanged: MATCH_LANGSUNG. Direct match from KBLI 2020 with no changes to the fundamental business definition.
intel_2026.baliContext: Karaoke venues in Bali range from high-end KTV clubs in Kuta and Denpasar to smaller family-style establishments in tourist areas. The business model combines entertainment (karaoke systems, private rooms) with beverage service. Audio equipment quality is critical — guests expect professional sound systems and extensive song libraries. The barrier to entry is relatively low for small venues, but larger karaoke establishments require significant audio/video infrastructure investment. Securing the Food Hygiene and Sanitation Label (HSP) from the local health department is essential. Ensure proper soundproofing to avoid noise complaints from neighboring properties.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 56102 — Food Stalls/Warung (if you serve light prepared meals alongside your drinks)
- 47222 — Retail of Non-Alcoholic Beverages (if you sell packaged beverages to customers)
- 56301 — If you operate a bar area alongside karaoke rooms

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Food trucks and mobile street food — preparing and serving food from motorized or non-motorized vehicles, carts, or mobile stalls. This includes food trucks, mobile kitchens, street food carts, and pop-up food stalls that can relocate. If your food operation moves on wheels or is designed to be mobile, this is your code.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Micro + Small scale**: Medium-Low risk. NIB + Standard Certificate issued **automatically**. You need a Hygiene Sanitation Label (HSP) and periodic activity reports.

Vehicle registration and street vending permits are separate requirements from the KBLI license.

**PMA:** Fully open — 100% foreign ownership allowed.
intel_2026.whatChanged: This is a completely new code in KBLI 2025 — it didn't exist in 2020 (BPS_ONLY status). The government created it to capture the growing mobile food and street food economy. If you were running a food truck before, you were likely classified under 56102 (food stalls) or general trade codes.
intel_2026.baliContext: Food trucks are having a moment in Bali — Canggu's shortcut road, Berawa's evening spots, and beachside locations in Seminyak. Mobile food offers lower overhead than restaurants and the flexibility to follow crowds. Vehicle permits, parking agreements, and local banjar approvals are the real operational hurdles. Many food trucks partner with beach clubs or events for semi-permanent locations. For PMA investors, the lower scale means smaller investment requirements compared to full restaurants.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 56101 — If you later move into a permanent restaurant location
- 56102 — If operating from semi-permanent stalls/warungs
- 49295 — If your food truck operates as a chartered transport vehicle

video gim dalam jaringan (game online).

data.uraian:
PEMERINTAH
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas pembuatan atau produksi gambar
bergerak, termasuk film, video, karya audiovisual (misalnya animasi
2D, 3D, animasi stopmotion, atau gabungan dari beberapa teknik
animasi tersebut), program televisi, iklan bergerak televisi, program
berita televisi, vlog (video blogging), dan siniar video (podcast video)
yang dikelola oleh pemerintah atas dasar balas jasa.
Kelompok ini juga mencakup
- aktivitas pembuatan konten media olahraga dalam bentuk film,
video, atau program televisi yang dikelola oleh pemerintah;
- aktivitas pembuatan film untuk penayangan televisi, serta jasa
pengiriman film dan agen pembukuan film yang dikelola oleh
pemerintah.
Kelompok ini tidak mencakup
- aktivitas penggandaan film dan reproduksi rekaman audio atau

data.judul: AKTIVITAS PASCAPRODUKSI FILM, VIDEO, DAN PROGRAM
data.uraian:
TELEVISI OLEH PEMERINTAH
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas pascaproduksi film, video, karya
audiovisual, dan program televisi, seperti editing, cutting, dubbing,
titling dan credit film, closed captioning, animasi dan special effects,
transfer film atau tape, konversi ke format video streaming, termasuk
kegiatan studio perfilman dan studio khusus film animasi yang
melakukan pengembangan dan pemrosesan film dan reproduksi film
untuk distribusi ke bioskop, serta kegiatan dokumentasi
rekaman/stock footage film atau gambar bergerak lain yang dikelola
oleh pemerintah atas dasar balas jasa.
Kelompok ini juga mencakup
- aktivitas pascaproduksi film, video, dan/atau program televisi
yang memuat konten media olahraga yang dikelola oleh
pemerintah;
- aktivitas penyensoran film, video, dan/atau program televisi yang
dilakukan oleh badan usaha atau pelaku usaha yang dikelola
pemerintah sebagai bagian dari proses pascaproduksi.

data.uraian:

perolehan dan pendaftaran hak cipta untuk gubahan musik; promosi,
pemberian izin, dan penggunaan gubahan musik dalam perekaman,

buku lembaran musik (buku partitur).

data.uraian:
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas penyelenggaraan jasa penyiaran
radio menggunakan sinyal analog di dalam studio penyiaran radio dan
fasilitas untuk transmisi audio kepada publik, afiliasi, dan/atau
pelanggan melalui teresterial, kabel, atau satelit.
Kelompok ini tidak mencakup
- aktivitas jasa penyiaran radio menggunakan sinyal digital, lihat

persyaratan: Menyampaikan rencana penyelenggaraan penyiaran yang memuat: a. Latar belakang, maksud, dan tujuan pendirian, serta mencantumkan nama, visi, misi, dan format siaran b. Uraian tentang proyeksi pendapatan (revenue) dari iklan dan/atau pendapatan lain yang sah yang terkait dengan penyelenggaraan penyiaran c. Daftar modal yang ditempatkan dan disetor, serta susunan kepemilikan saham perusahaan d. Mencantumkan kepemilikan saham pada lembaga penyiaran swasta jasa penyiaran radio yang sudah dimiliki oleh pemegang saham e. Mencantumkan daftar media cetak, lembaga penyiaran swasta jasa penyiaran radio, lembaga penyiaran swasta jasa penyiaran televisi dan/atau lembaga penyiaran berlangganan yang sudah dimiliki oleh Pelaku Usaha f. Peta wilayah jangkauan siaran g. Sarana dan prasarana penyiaran mencakup kantor, spesifikasi perangkat, dan konfigurasi teknis sistem penyiaran
Menyampaikan daftar susunan pengurus untuk membuktikan direksi dan komisaris badan hukum Pelaku Usaha tidak ditetapkan dalam daftar hitam penyelenggara

Menyampaikan surat pernyataan: a. Sanggup membayar biaya izin penyelenggaraan penyiaran sesuai dengan ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan b. Sanggup memenuhi dokumen kerja sama dengan penyelenggara layanan multipleksing dalam hal akan menyelenggarakan penyiaran dengan teknologi digital melalui media terestrial c. Sanggup memenuhi persyaratan izin penggunaan spektrum frekuensi radio (ISR) sesuai dengan ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan d. Sanggup memenuhi ketentuan penyelenggaraan penyiaran sesuai dengan ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan e. Sanggup memenuhi ketentuan terkait isi siaran sesuai dengan ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan f. Sanggup membangun dan/atau menyediakan sarana dan prasarana penyiaran berdasarkan ketentuan peraturan perundang undangan sebelum mengajukan permohonan uji laik operasi penyiaran g. Sanggup menyampaikan dokumen yang valid dan benar
Dalam hal penyelenggaraan jasa penyiaran radio digital dengan media terrestrial, wajib melampirkan dokumen kerja sama dengan penyelenggara layanan multipleksing
Mengajukan permohonan uji laik operasi penyiaran setelah membangun dan/atau menyediakan sarana dan prasarana penyiaran berdasarkan ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan
Memperoleh surat keterangan laik operasi penyiaran berdasarkan pelaksanaan uji laik operasi penyiaran sesuai standar kegiatan usaha
Membayar biaya izin penyelenggaraan penyiaran dalam jangka waktu 15 (lima belas) hari kerja sejak surat perintah pembayaran diterbitkan

Pelaku Usaha yang telah memperoleh Perizinan Berusaha penyelenggaraan penyiaran dapat memperpanjang Perizinan Berusaha penyelenggaraan penyiaran setelah dilakukan evaluasi pada bulan ke 6 (enam) sampai dengan bulan ke 5 (lima) sebelum masa laku Perizinan Berusaha penyelenggaraan penyiaran berakhir, dengan persyaratan sebagai berikut: a. Pengajuan perpanjangan Perizinan Berusaha penyelenggaraan penyiaran paling cepat 4 (empat) bulan dan paling lambat 3 (tiga) bulan sebelum berakhirnya Perizinan Berusaha penyelenggaraan penyiaran dan memenuhi catatan hasil evaluasi atau dinyatakan layak b. Tidak memiliki kewajiban Penerimaan Negara Bukan Pajak yang terhutang kepada kementerian yang menyelenggarakan urusan pemerintahan di bidang komunikasi dan informatika c. Dalam hal menggunakan spektrum frekuensi radio, wajib menyampaikan izin penggunaan spektrum frekuensi radio (ISR) yang masih berlaku d. Dalam hal menggunakan slot multipleksing, wajib menyampaikan dokumen kerja sama dengan penyelenggara layanan multipleksing sesuai dengan ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan e. Membayar biaya Izin penyelenggaraan Penyiaran dalam jangka waktu 2 (dua) bulan sejak surat perintah pembayaran diterbitkan
per_skala.jangka_waktu: 29 Hari (7 Hari untuk verifikasi persyaratan administratif; 15 Hari untuk verifikasi persyaratan uji laik operasi; dan 7 Hari untuk verifikasi persyaratan biaya izin)
kewajiban: Tidak melanggar ketentuan larangan berupa siaran iklan niaga yang dilakukan dengan: a. Promosi yang dihubungkan dengan ajaran suatu agama, ideologi, pribadi dan/atau kelompok, yang menyinggung perasaan dan/atau merendahkan martabat agama lain, ideologi lain, pribadi lain, atau kelompok lain b. Promosi minuman keras atau sejenisnya dan bahan atau zat adiktif c. Promosi rokok yang memperagakan wujud rokok d. Hal-hal yang bertentangan dengan kesusilaan masyarakat dan nilai-nilai agama e. Eksploitasi anak di bawah umur 18 (delapan belas) tahun
Isi siaran sesuai dengan perlindungan hak cipta dan ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan
Membayar biaya izin penyelenggaraan penyiaran berdasarkan zona sesuai ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan
Dilarang memindahtangankan Perizinan Berusaha penyelenggaraan penyiaran kepada pihak lain
Tidak melanggar ketentuan larangan tidak melakukan siaran lebih dari 3 (tiga) bulan secara akumulatif tanpa pemberitahuan berdasarkan alasan yang sah
Memenuhi ketentuan rencana dasar teknik penyiaran dan persyaratan teknis perangkat penyiaran
Menyampaikan laporan penyelenggaraan penyiaran kepada Menteri yang menyelenggarakan urusan pemerintahan di bidang komunikasi dan informatika
Memenuhi ketentuan isi siaran sesuai dengan ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan
Melaksanakan kewajiban penyelenggaraan penyiaran sesuai dengan ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan
Memperoleh PB UMKU izin Stasiun Radio dalam hal menggunakan spektrum frekuensi radio
pb_umku: Izin Stasiun Radio (dalam hal menggunakan Spektrum Frekuensi Radio dalam bentuk Kanal Frekuensi Radio)
per_skala.parameter: Seluruh
per_skala.sanksi_pencabutan: Pencabutan persyaratan dasar, PB, dan/atau PB UMKU

data.uraian:
TELEKOMUNIKASI LAINNYA
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas penjualan kembali dan jasa
intermediasi untuk telekomunikasi lainnya, termasuk
- aktivitas penjualan kembali jasa telekomunikasi kabel, nirkabel,
dan satelit (misalnya membeli dan menjual kembali kapasitas
jaringan), termasuk kegiatan broker telekomunikasi dan penjualan
kembali kartu panggil prabayar, serta aktivitas terkait;
- aktivitas jasa intermediasi untuk kegiatan telekomunikasi kabel,
nirkabel, dan satelit, termasuk aktivitas agen untuk operator
telekomunikasi, penjualan paket layanan telepon seluler atas
dasar keagenan, aktivitas agen penjualan paket layanan telepon
nirkabel yang menjual atas nama operator telekomunikasi
nirkabel, serta aktivitas agen untuk operator jaringan virtual
seluler (MVNO);
- aktivitas penyediaan akses telepon dan internet di fasilitas yang
terbuka untuk publik, seperti warung telepon (wartel) dan warung
internet (warnet).

data.uraian:
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas penyelenggaraan jasa
telekomunikasi khusus yang menggunakan teknologi dan/atau
jaringan satelit, baik untuk kebutuhan komunikasi, navigasi,
pemantauan, hingga penginderaan jauh, tetapi bukan sebagai
penyedia konektivitas umum, termasuk
- penyediaan aplikasi telekomunikasi khusus, seperti pelacakan
satelit (satellite tracking), telemetri komunikasi, dan
pengoperasian stasiun radar;
- pengoperasian stasiun terminal satelit (stasiun bumi) dan fasilitas
terkait di permukaan bumi yang terhubung secara operasional
dengan satu atau lebih sistem komunikasi terestrial, untuk
keperluan transmisi atau penerimaan komunikasi dari satelit;
- pengoperasian satelit di orbit untuk keperluan penginderaan jauh,
navigasi, dan telekomunikasi khusus, misalnya pengoperasian
satelit telekomunikasi orbit rendah bumi (LEO).

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Technical development of video games — coding, engine creation, middleware, game software. Includes design/writing/testing/patching game code. Does NOT include game publishing (58211/58219) or game content design (74194).
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Small / Medium scale**: Medium-Low risk. NIB + Standard Certificate issued **automatically**. Must have SOP for after-sales service, competency training certificates, org chart with technical staff, guarantee no SARA content, age rating recommendations.

**Large scale**: Medium-High risk. NIB + Standard Certificate verified within **7 working days**. Needs staffing documentation (min 2 managers, 2 supervisors, 4 operational staff). Also has AI/blockchain sub-requirements (data governance annual report, SKKNI AI competency).

**PMA:** Fully open — 100% foreign ownership allowed. Authority: Bupati/Walikota (small/medium), Gubernur (large).
intel_2026.whatChanged: MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE from KBLI 2020 codes 62011, 62012, 62013, 62015, 62019. Previously game dev was bundled under general software programming. KBLI 2025 creates a dedicated code recognizing Indonesia's game industry as distinct.
intel_2026.baliContext: Bali's game dev scene is small but growing, centered in Canggu coworking spaces. Most indie studios are 2-5 person teams. The IDR 10B PMA minimum makes this prohibitive for small studios — most operate as freelancers or use nominee structures. Denpasar Technopark has programs supporting game development. The key advantage of Bali is lifestyle + lower cost than Jakarta/Singapore, attracting remote game developers. However, fast internet is still inconsistent outside south Bali.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 74194 — Game Content Design (art direction, level design, narrative)
- 58211 — Game Publishing (online distribution)
- 58219 — Other Game Publishing
- 62199 — Other Software Development (for non-game tools)
- 73100 — Advertising (if you market games directly)
intel_2026.zantaraOpener: Building games from Bali? 62110 is your dedicated code for game development — let me explain the licensing and what changed in 2025.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Programming and developing e-commerce applications — platforms that enable electronic trading of goods/services via the internet. Covers app design, coding, testing, patching for marketplace and e-commerce systems. Does NOT include IT consulting (62209) or running the marketplace itself.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Small / Medium scale**: Medium-Low risk. NIB + Standard Certificate issued **automatically**. Must maintain data security SOP, competency certificates, org chart with technical SDM.

**Large scale**: Medium-High risk. NIB + Standard Certificate verified within **7 working days**. Needs minimum staffing (2 managers, 2 supervisors, 4 staff) plus equipment documentation.

**PMA:** Fully open — 100% foreign ownership allowed.
intel_2026.whatChanged: CODICE_RINUMERATO from KBLI 2020 code 62012. Previously e-commerce app development was grouped with general application development. KBLI 2025 isolates it, reflecting the sector's economic importance. This is about BUILDING the platform, not OPERATING it (which falls under different codes).
intel_2026.baliContext: E-commerce development is booming for Bali-based tech teams building platforms for local craft, wellness, and tourism niches. Many Bali startups build marketplace apps connecting local artisans with global buyers. The developer talent pool in Bali is thinner than Jakarta — expect to recruit remotely. Coworking hubs like Dojo Bali and Outpost serve as informal dev team gathering points.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: App development and digital content production — designing, coding, testing, and maintaining mobile apps, web applications, and digital media content. This is the go-to code for digital agencies, app studios, content production houses, and any company that both builds software and produces the digital content that lives inside it. Think social media tools, educational apps, interactive content platforms.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Small / Medium scale**: Medium-Low risk (Menengah Rendah). NIB + Standard Certificate issued **automatically**. Must maintain data security SOPs, submit industry data reports every 6 months, and have competency training certificates for technical staff.

**Large scale**: Medium-High risk (Menengah Tinggi). NIB + Standard Certificate verified within **7 working days**. Requires org chart with qualified technical staff, employment contracts for skilled workers, business process documentation, and equipment inventory with photos.

**PMA:** Fully open — 100% foreign ownership allowed.
intel_2026.whatChanged: MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE — this code consolidated several previously separate activities from KBLI 2020. App development and digital content production used to be spread across multiple codes. KBLI 2025 recognizes that in practice, most digital agencies do both — build the app AND produce the content — so it merged them into one code.
intel_2026.baliContext: This is arguably the most relevant code for Bali's booming digital agency scene. Canggu and Seminyak are full of small studios building apps and producing content for international clients. The automatic licensing at Small/Medium scale makes it very startup-friendly. The main practical consideration: if you're producing content that includes video or audio streaming, you may need additional codes (60103, 60203) which carry much heavier licensing. Stick to apps and non-broadcast digital content and this code keeps things simple.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: General software development and programming — designing, writing, modifying, testing, and supporting computer code for software systems and applications. This is the catch-all code for IT companies that build custom software, web apps, mobile apps, SaaS products, and enterprise systems. If you write code for a living and it doesn't fit into gaming (62110), e-commerce apps (62191), or AI (62194), this is your code.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Small + Medium**: Two licensing paths:
- **Medium-Low risk**: NIB + Standard Certificate **automatically**. Must submit industry data reports every 6 months, have data security SOPs.
- **Medium-High risk**: 7-day processing. Needs org chart with qualified staff, employment contracts for skilled workers, business process documentation, equipment list with photos.

**Large**: Medium-High risk, 7-day processing, same requirements as above.

**PMA:** Fully open — 100% foreign ownership. This is one of the easiest codes for foreign tech companies.
intel_2026.whatChanged: The 2025 code aggregated from the old 62029 (other computer consulting activities) via MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE. The 2020 landscape had fewer, broader IT codes. Now there's more granularity — gaming, e-commerce, AI, and IoT all got their own codes, leaving 62199 as the general programming catchall.
intel_2026.baliContext: Bali's tech scene is real and growing. Canggu is the unofficial digital nomad capital of Southeast Asia, and many of those nomads have formed companies here. Running a software company from Bali as a PT PMA is straightforward — 100% foreign ownership, automatic licensing at smaller scales. The talent pool is a mix of Indonesian developers (Denpasar has several good universities) and international remote workers. Co-working spaces like Dojo Bali and Outpost cater specifically to tech companies. Pro tip: if your PT PMA builds software, you can employ up to 10 foreign workers on KITAS without the stringent 1:1 local hiring ratios that other industries face.

For Bali-based cybersecurity consultancies, the main challenge is the staffing requirements: even a small firm needs formal employment contracts with technically certified staff. The good news is 100% PMA is allowed, making this one of the most accessible high-value IT niches for foreign experts.

data.judul: AKTIVITAS PENYEDIAAN DAN PENGELOLAAN IDENTITAS DIGITAL
data.uraian:
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas penyediaan dan pengelolaan
identitas digital sebagai representasi entitas (individu, organisasi, atau
perangkat) dalam sistem elektronik. Aktivitas ini meliputi konsultansi,
perencanaan, pengembangan, pengoperasian, dan peme liharaan
sistem identitas digital, termasuk
- registrasi, verifikasi, dan validasi identitas digital;
- pengelolaan kredensial digital seperti nomor unik, akun pengguna,
sertifikat elektronik, atau token;
- autentikasi dan otorisasi pengguna dalam sistem digital;
- manajemen atribut identitas, seperti biografis, biometrik, legal
identifier, dan unique identifier;
- penyediaan layanan identitas digital dengan berbagai tingkat
kepercayaan (level of assurance) berdasarkan risiko.
Kelompok ini juga mencakup aktivitas integrasi identitas digital ke
dalam sistem informasi klien sebagai bagian dari solusi keamanan
informasi.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: IT consulting and computer facility management — advising on hardware/software configurations, planning and designing computer systems, managing data centers, providing system administration services. If you help businesses with their tech infrastructure rather than building software products, this is your code.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Small + Medium**: Medium-High risk. NIB + Standard Certificate within **7 working days**. Requirements are substantial:
- Org chart showing qualified technical staff
- Employment contracts for skilled workers (must be permanent employees, not freelancers)
- Business process flow documentation
- Equipment list with photos
- If producing medical devices: additional healthcare certifications
- Must submit industry data every 6 months
- SOPs for after-sales service and data security

**Large**: Same Medium-High risk, 7-day processing, same requirements.

**PMA:** Fully open — 100% foreign ownership.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Renumbered from 62029 in KBLI 2020 (CODICE_RINUMERATO) with a 100% match. The old code covered 'other computer consulting' activities. In 2025 it's split into more specific categories — cybersecurity (62201), digital identity (62202), electronic certificates (62203), IoT consulting (62204), and this general catch-all 62209.
intel_2026.baliContext: IT consulting in Bali serves two markets: local businesses going digital (hotels, restaurants, retail — lots of demand) and international clients served remotely. Many digital agencies in Bali operate under this code — web design firms, IT managed service providers, and system integrators. The 7-day licensing timeline is manageable. The biggest requirement hurdle is demonstrating permanent employees (not contractors), which can be tricky for lean tech operations. Denpasar and Sanur have more traditional IT firms; Canggu and Ubud skew toward digital agencies and remote consulting.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 62199 — If you also build custom software
- 62201 — If you specifically do cybersecurity consulting
- 63102 — If you provide hosting/data center services
- 95101 — If you repair computers and equipment
intel_2026.zantaraOpener: Running an IT consulting or managed services company from Bali? 62209 is your code — here's what the 2025 requirements look like.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: The catch-all code for IT services that don't fit anywhere else — any information technology or computer service activity not specifically classified under other 62xxx codes. This includes miscellaneous IT support, niche tech services, and hybrid IT activities that straddle multiple categories.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**BPS_ONLY** — this code exists in the BPS classification but has NOT yet been assigned PP28 risk/licensing data. Currently treated as requiring only a NIB, pending formal assignment.

**CAUTION:** Using a catch-all code for a PMA company can trigger additional scrutiny from BKPM. Reviewers may ask why you didn't use a more specific code — an unsatisfying answer can delay NIB processing.

**PMA:** Fully open — 100% foreign ownership allowed.
intel_2026.whatChanged: BPS_ONLY — this code has no mapped predecessor in KBLI 2020. It exists purely in the BPS classification system without corresponding PP28 licensing parameters. Regulators focus on defining specific activities first and leave residual categories for later waves.
intel_2026.baliContext: Use this code with caution. If you're doing app development (62192), AI (62194), cybersecurity (62201), or IT consulting (62209), use those specific codes. The main legitimate use case is when your IT service genuinely doesn't fit any existing category. Some Bali business consultants recommend adding 62900 as a SECONDARY code alongside a specific primary code, giving flexibility to expand without amending your NIB. That's sound advice, but never make it your only code.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 62199 — Other Software Development (the more specific catch-all for programming)
- 62209 — IT Consulting (the more specific catch-all for consulting)
- 63900 — Web Portals & Digital Platforms
- 95101 — Computer & Peripheral Repair (if services include hardware)
intel_2026.zantaraOpener: Considering 62900 as your IT catch-all code? It works as a secondary code, but think carefully before making it your primary — BKPM will want to know why a specific code didn't fit.

Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas pengolahan dan tabulasi berbagai
jenis data, termasuk big data (baik terstruktur, semi terstruktur,
maupun tidak terstruktur) dan data citra satelit atau penginderaan
jauh. Aktivitas ini mencakup sebagian atau seluruh tahapa n
pengolahan data, meliputi
- persiapan data (misalnya entri data, migrasi data, pembersihan
data, dan normalisasi data);
- pengembangan algoritma untuk penyimpanan dan pengolahan
data;
- pengolahan data dan pembuatan laporan khusus berdasarkan
data yang disediakan oleh klien/pemilik data, yang dilakukan oleh
data controller atau data processor, termasuk pengolahan data
menggunakan blockchain atau distributed ledger technology
(DLT).
Kelompok ini juga mencakup aktivitas pembagian fasilitas komputasi
untuk pemrosesan dan analisis data, digitalisasi dokumen (untuk
keperluan pengolahan data lebih lanjut), pengelolaan data besar (big
data management), dan penyediaan layanan informasi dari data yang
diolah.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Data Processing Activities — covering the processing and tabulation of various data types, including big data, satellite imagery, and data entry. It involves algorithm development, data migration, processing via blockchain or distributed ledger technology (DLT), digitalizing documents, and sharing computing facilities for analysis.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
Three distinct licensing tiers from aggregated PP28 sources (63121, 63111):

**Tier 1 — Kecil/Menengah**: Low risk (Rendah). NIB only, issued **automatically**. Validated Industrial Data reports every 6 months. Data security SOPs. HR competency training certificates. Authority: Bupati/Walikota.

**Tier 2 — Kecil/Menengah**: Medium-Low risk (Menengah Rendah). NIB + Standard Certificate, issued **automatically**. Same data reporting obligations plus: equipment calibration certificates, organizational structure documentation showing qualified technical staff, and safety/security guarantees for tools and processes. Authority: Bupati/Walikota.

**Tier 3 — Besar**: Medium-High risk (Menengah Tinggi). NIB + Standard Certificate within **7 days**. Requires: organizational chart with qualified staff, employment contracts for at least 2 managers + 2 supervisors + 4 technical staff (permanent or minimum 1-year contract), business process flow documentation, equipment list with photos. Authority: Gubernur.

**Post-issuance obligations (all tiers):**
- Submit validated Industrial Data every 6 months (Data Industri tervalidasi)
- Maintain SOPs for data and electronic system security (SOP keamanan data dan sistem elektronik)
- Obtain HR competency training certificates (sertifikat pelatihan kompetensi SDM)

**PMA Status:** Fully open (Terbuka) — 100% foreign ownership.

**Source Regulation:** PP 28/2025 (aggregated from 63121, 63111).
intel_2026.whatChanged: MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE. Expanded heavily in the 2025 update to explicitly include big data, remote sensing, and blockchain/DLT processing.
intel_2026.baliContext: Bali has become a global hub for Web3, crypto, and AI startups. Rather than dealing with complex financial licenses, many foreign tech founders set up 'Data Processing' PT PMAs. If you are training AI models, running blockchain validator nodes, or operating a back-office data analytics hub for your overseas parent company, 63101 is your golden ticket. The explicit inclusion of blockchain gives immense legal clarity to Web3 founders. It allows you to legally hire local developers and sponsor expat IT talent with Investor KITAS. Since it requires zero physical retail presence, you can legally domicile in a co-working space in Canggu or Sanur. Just ensure your data privacy SOPs strictly comply with Indonesia's Personal Data Protection (PDP) law.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 63102 — Cloud/Hosting Infrastructure (if you also provide the servers for the data)
- 62199 — Other Computer Programming (the standard code for software engineering)
- 70209 — Management Consulting (if you advise other companies based on your data analytics)
intel_2026.zantaraOpener: Running an AI, Big Data, or Web3 startup from Bali? KBLI 63101 now explicitly covers blockchain and data processing, making it perfect for tech PMAs.

data.uraian:
DAN AKTIVITAS TERKAIT
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas penyediaan infrastruktur komputasi
dan hosting, serta berbagai jasa terkait lainnya yang mendukung
aktivitas pengelolaan dan distribusi data secara digital, termasuk
penyediaan infrastruktur komputasi awan (cloud computing),  seperti
layanan Infrastructure as a Service (Iaas) dan Platform as a Service
(PaaS); penyediaan layanan hosting, seperti web hosting, hosting
layanan streaming (tanpa mengelola atau mengkurasi konten), dan
aplikasi hosting.
Kelompok ini juga mencakup penyediaan fasilitas mainframe secara
bersama (time sharing) kepada klien, penyewaan ruang server dan
jaringan dalam pusat data (data center colocation), penyimpanan data
dan dokumen secara elektronik untuk keperluan akses terbatas, serta
layanan penyimpanan data komputer lainnya.
Kelompok ini tidak mencakup aktivitas pengolahan data dan entri data

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Computing Infrastructure, Hosting, and Related Activities — providing cloud computing infrastructure (IaaS, PaaS), web hosting, application hosting, and streaming hosting (without content curation). It also covers server room colocation, electronic document storage, and sharing mainframe facilities. It explicitly excludes pure data processing.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Micro**: Low risk (Rendah) processed automatically. **Small, Medium**: Medium-Low (Menengah Rendah) to Medium-High risk. **Large**: Medium-High to High Risk (Tinggi). Depending on risk, requires NIB, NIB + Standard Certificate (Sertifikat Standar), or an Izin (taking up to 7 days).

**Post-issuance obligations:**
- Maintain an Electronic System Provider Registration Certificate from Kominfo (Surat Tanda Terdaftar Penyelenggara Sistem Elektronik / PSE)
- Submit validated Industrial Data (Memiliki bukti penyampaian wajib Data Industri)
- Establish consumer complaint services (Memiliki layanan pengaduan konsumen)
- Implement data security SOPs (Memiliki SOP keamanan data)

**Authority:** Ranges from Regent/Mayor (Bupati/Walikota) to Minister/Head of Agency (Menteri/Kepala Badan) depending on risk.

**PMA Status:** Fully open (Terbuka) — 100% foreign ownership.

**Source Regulation:** PP 28/2025, Perpres 10/2021, 49/2021, 14/2024.
intel_2026.whatChanged: MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE. Separated and updated from broader processing codes to explicitly define modern cloud infrastructure, IaaS, and PaaS models.
intel_2026.baliContext: While Bali isn't a primary location for massive Tier 4 data centers (due to power grid stability and internet redundancy limitations compared to Jakarta), boutique server hosting, specialized Web3 nodes, SaaS platforms, and localized cloud infrastructure businesses do exist here. Foreign investors use this code to legally build and manage private tech infrastructure. The critical obligation here is the PSE Registration (Surat Tanda Terdaftar Penyelenggara Sistem Elektronik) from the Ministry of Communication and Informatics (Kominfo). If you operate a commercial app or hosting service and fail to register for a PSE, the Indonesian government will block your IP address nationally. Also, power redundancy for server cooling in Bali's tropical climate will be your biggest overhead.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 63101 — Data Processing (if you also process the data hosted on your servers)
- 62209 — IT Consulting (to provide wrap-around architecture services for your clients)
- 46511 — Wholesale of Computers/Hardware (if you import and sell server racks)
intel_2026.zantaraOpener: Building cloud infrastructure or SaaS hosting services in Bali? KBLI 63102 is fully open to PMA, but your Kominfo PSE registration is an absolute, non-negotiable requirement.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Web portals, search engines, and fee-based information services. Think of any website or platform whose primary value is aggregating and presenting information — news portals, directory sites, vertical search engines, data lookup tools. This is NOT a marketplace or e-commerce platform (that's 63122). If your site's main product is organized information rather than facilitating transactions between buyers and sellers, 63900 is the right fit.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Micro scale**: Low risk (Rendah). NIB only — no Standard Certificate required. This is the lightest licensing path in the entire KBLI system. You register, you get your NIB, you operate.

**Small / Medium / Large scale**: Not listed in the risk data at these scales, which means Micro is the only explicitly mapped tier. In practice, if your operation grows beyond micro, expect the licensing authority to apply at minimum Medium-Low requirements.

**PMA:** Fully open — 100% foreign ownership allowed.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Direct match from KBLI 2020 (MATCH_LANGSUNG). No structural changes. Web portals and information services keep the same code and scope.
intel_2026.baliContext: This is a popular code for digital entrepreneurs running content sites, niche directories, or information platforms from Bali. The low-risk micro classification makes it one of the easiest tech codes to set up. Many Bali-based expats use this for travel information portals, wellness directories, or local business listing sites. Just be careful not to cross into marketplace territory — if your portal starts facilitating transactions, you may need 63122 instead.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 63101 — Data Processing (if you also host or process data for third parties)
- 63102 — Cloud Infrastructure & Hosting (if you run your own server infrastructure)
- 73100 — Advertising (if ad revenue is a primary income stream)
- 62199 — Software Development (if you're also building custom software products)
intel_2026.zantaraOpener: Running a web portal or information platform from Indonesia? 63900 is your code — and at micro scale, it's one of the simplest licenses in the entire system.

yang serupa dengan simpanan dan pemberian kredit atau bentuk

pinjaman hipotek dan kartu kredit konsumen. Kegiatan ini pada
umumnya dilakukan oleh lembaga keuangan selain bank sentral,
seperti jasa perantara keuangan yang tidak diklasifikasikan di tempat
lain, misalnya kegiatan giro pos, tabungan pos, lembaga khusus
penerima simpanan yang berwenang memberikan kredit misalnya
untuk pembelian rumah, dan aktivitas order bayar.

- aktivitas penyimpanan uang dan pemberian kredit oleh koperasi

berdasarkan prinsip syariah, lihat kelompok 64192;

kelompok 64193;

kredit misalnya untuk pembelian rumah (lihat subgolongan 6492);
- aktivitas pemrosesan dan penyelesaian transaksi kartu kredit
(lihat 6619).

intel_2026.baliContext: The PT PMA holding structure (64210 parent → operational subsidiaries) is the preferred structure for foreign investors with multiple business lines in Bali — it allows clean liability separation between hospitality (55101), F&B (56101), real estate (68111), and other operations. OECD Pillar Two global minimum tax (15%) has reduced the tax arbitrage benefit of holding structures, but operational benefits remain significant.

Foreign life insurers can own up to 80% — but must meet minimum local market capitalization. Bali's expat community creates demand for international health and life products.

Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan penjaminan proteksi finansial
terhadap dana nasabah yang disimpan di bank serta klaim polis yang
timbul dari produk asuransi. Penjaminan ini didanai melalui
kontribusi berkala yang dibayarkan oleh lembaga keuangan tersebut.

Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pemberian penjaminan oleh
penjamin atas pemenuhan kewajiban finansial terjamin kepada
penerima jaminan yang diselenggarakan secara konvensional,
termasuk
- penjaminan kredit dan pembiayaan yang diberikan oleh lembaga
keuangan;
- penjaminan pinjaman yang disalurkan oleh koperasi simpan
pinjam atau koperasi yang mempunyai unit usaha simpan pinjam
kepada anggotanya;
- penjaminan kredit dan/atau pinjaman program kemitraan yang
disalurkan oleh badan usaha milik negara dalam rangka program
kemitraan dan bina lingkungan.
- penjaminan atas surat utang, penjaminan pembelian barang
secara angsuran, penjaminan transaksi dagang, penjaminan
pengadaan barang dan/atau jasa (surety bond), penjaminan bank
garansi (kontra bank garansi), penjaminan surat kredit
berdokumen dalam negeri, penjaminan letter of credit, penjaminan
kepabeanan (customs bond), penjaminan cukai, pemberian jasa
konsultasi manajemen terkait dengan kegiatan usaha penjaminan,
dan kegiatan penjaminan lainnya.

Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan penjaminan atas pemenuhan
kewajiban finansial terjamin kepada penerima jaminan berdasarkan
prinsip syariah, termasuk
- penjaminan pembiayaan berdasarkan prinsip syariah yang
diberikan oleh lembaga keuangan;
- penjaminan pinjaman atau pembiayaan yang disalurkan oleh

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Money changer (licensed foreign exchange) activities — buying and selling foreign currency notes, traveler's checks, and conducting currency exchange transactions. A Bank Indonesia-regulated business that provides foreign exchange services to the public.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Micro / Small / Medium / Large scale**: Medium-Low risk. NIB + Standard Certificate — issued automatically.


**PMA:** Fully open to PMA — 100% foreign ownership allowed.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Renumbered/adjusted from KBLI 2020. KBLI 66125 invariato 2020→2025 (sotto categoria 6612 — Aktivitas Perantara Transaksi). Aggiornamento OSS entro 18 giugno 2026. BI regolatore esclusivo tramite PBI 6/2024 e PADG cor
intel_2026.baliContext: Bali has one of Indonesia's densest money changer networks — tourist demand from international visitors creates massive foreign currency volume. Bank Indonesia (BI) licenses money changers as KUPVA BB (Kegiatan Usaha Penukaran Valuta Asing Bukan Bank). BI issued a moratorium on new money changer licenses in Jakarta but Bali licenses remain available. All transactions above IDR 25 million require customer identity verification (KYC/AML compliance under BI Regulation 19/2017). Cryptocurrency-to-fiat exchange is NOT permitted under a money changer license.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- Bank Indonesia KUPVA BB license — mandatory separate from OSS
- 64110 — If you want to operate as a full bank
intel_2026.zantaraOpener: Opening a money changer in Bali? Let me explain the Bank Indonesia KUPVA BB licensing process and AML compliance requirements.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Investment advisory services — providing professional advice to clients on investment decisions, portfolio allocation, and financial planning, whether for securities, real estate, or other asset classes. You advise, you don't manage or trade on behalf of clients.

intel_2026.baliContext: Investment advisory in the securities market requires OJK registration as a Penasihat Investasi (PI) under POJK 10/2018. Advisors who manage client portfolios cross into fund management territory (66301). The growing number of wealthy foreigners investing in Bali's property and business market creates demand for locally-based investment advisors. IFRS and Indonesian PSAK accounting standards knowledge is important for cross-border advisory.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- OJK Penasihat Investasi license — if advising on securities
- 66301 — Investment management if you actively manage funds
intel_2026.zantaraOpener: Investment advisory services in Bali? Let me explain OJK licensing and the scope of advice you can legally provide.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Conventional fintech peer-to-peer lending platform — operating an online platform that facilitates direct lending between individual or institutional lenders and borrowers without going through a traditional bank. Often called P2P Lending or marketplace lending.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Micro / Small / Medium / Large scale**: Medium-Low risk. NIB + Standard Certificate — issued automatically.


**PMA:** Fully open to PMA — 100% foreign ownership allowed.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Renumbered/adjusted from KBLI 2020. KBLI 66161 invariato 2020→2025. POJK 40/2024 framework attuale (sostituisce POJK 10/2022). UU P2SK base legislativa. Aggiornamento OSS entro 18 giugno 2026. POJK 3/2024 (ITSK) gove
intel_2026.baliContext: P2P lending in Indonesia is regulated by OJK under POJK 10/2022 (LPBBTI) — all platforms must register and then obtain full OJK licenses. Minimum paid-up capital Rp 25 billion (conventional). Maximum interest rates and penalty caps are set by AFPI (Indonesian Fintech Lending Association). Bali-based tech startups in Canggu have explored P2P lending models for tourism businesses and creative industry financing. Consumer protection regulations are strictly enforced.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- OJK P2P lending license — mandatory (registration then licensing)
- 66162 — Sharia P2P lending for Islamic finance version
intel_2026.zantaraOpener: Building a P2P lending platform in Bali? Let me explain OJK licensing, minimum capital, and the regulatory framework under POJK 10/2022.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Sharia-compliant fintech peer-to-peer lending — P2P financing under Islamic finance principles using mudharabah, musharakah, or qardh structures instead of conventional interest-bearing loans. Regulated separately from conventional P2P but under the same OJK framework.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Micro / Small / Medium / Large scale**: Medium-Low risk. NIB + Standard Certificate — issued automatically.


**PMA:** Fully open to PMA — 100% foreign ownership allowed.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Renumbered/adjusted from KBLI 2020. KBLI 66162 invariato 2020→2025 come codice distinto dal convenzionale. POJK 40/2024 copre entrambe le versioni. Prima codificazione esplicita come attività separata nel KBLI 2025.
intel_2026.baliContext: Sharia P2P lending targets Indonesia's large underbanked Muslim population — significant addressable market. DSN-MUI fatwa compliance is required alongside OJK licensing. Minimum paid-up capital Rp 25 billion for sharia P2P. Bali serves as a tech hub for fintech development targeting Indonesia-wide Muslim markets — the operational HQ may be in Bali while the customer base spans Java and Sumatra.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- OJK sharia P2P license — mandatory
- DSN-MUI fatwa — required for product structure
- 66161 — Conventional P2P (separate entity required)
intel_2026.zantaraOpener: Sharia-compliant P2P lending platform? Let me explain OJK licensing, DSN-MUI requirements, and how this differs from conventional P2P.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Developing and selling residential real estate — buying, selling, and developing houses, apartments, flats, and residential land. This covers the full property development cycle: acquire land, build residential buildings, and sell or lease them. Mobile home park development for residential use also falls here.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**All scales (Micro through Large)**: Medium-Low risk (Menengah Rendah). NIB + Standard Certificate (Sertifikat Standar) issued **automatically** (Otomatis).

**Key obligations:**
- **KKPR** (Kesesuaian Kegiatan Pemanfaatan Ruang) — spatial conformity permit for housing development, issued by ATR/BPN
- **Persyaratan Dasar** — basic business licensing requirements for smaller scales
- **MBR housing** (Masyarakat Berpenghasilan Rendah) — additional specific development requirements if building low-income housing
- **SK Pengesahan** from Pemda — master plan, land parcel split plans, management separation plans
- **Audited financials** — laporan keuangan audited by public accountant, with debt-to-equity ratios

**Authority chain:**
- **National:** Kementerian ATR/BPN (for KKPR), BKPM/OSS (for NIB)
- **Provincial:** Governor / DPMPTSP Provinsi
- **Local:** Bupati/Walikota — PP28 designates this level as primary licensing authority

**PMA:** Fully open (Terbuka) — 100% foreign ownership.

**⚠️ BALI GOVERNOR ALERT (Jan 2026):** The Governor of Bali has formally requested BKPM to CLOSE OSS registration for PMA companies operating Medium-Low risk (Menengah Rendah) activities in Bali — which directly includes 68111. This code is listed as the #1 most abused PMA code in Bali (Surat Gubernur B.27.000/642/PM/DPMPTSP, 28 January 2026). If BKPM grants this request, new PMA companies will be UNABLE to register 68111 for Bali operations. Existing NIBs are expected to remain valid. Monitor OSS for changes.

**Source Regulation:** PP 28/2025, Perpres 10/2021.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Unchanged from KBLI 2020 — direct match (MATCH_LANGSUNG). Residential real estate development stays the same.
intel_2026.baliContext:
**The Governor's numbers (Surat Gubernur, Jan 2026):**
- **19,262** PMA businesses registered in Bali (2021–2025) — that's 40% of all PMA nationally
- **55,458** projects across those PMA companies
- **47.55%** are low-risk requiring only NIB — nearly half face zero substantive oversight
- The letter also requests closure of PMA at **virtual office addresses** in Bali
- **68111** is cited as the single most abused PMA code in the province

---

**Bali real estate reality:**
- Land prices in south Bali (Canggu, Seminyak, Jimbaran) have **tripled in the last decade**
- **KKPR** (spatial conformity) is critical — Bali has strict zoning near temples, rice terraces, and waterways
- Foreigners **cannot own land freehold** (Hak Milik) — must use PT PMA
- Typical structure: **HGB** (Hak Guna Bangunan — building rights, 30 years + 20 year extension) held by the PT PMA

---

**Common client mistakes:**
- **Virtual office** for a real estate company — the Governor's letter specifically targets this, DPMPTSP Bali is actively flagging it
- **"Holding code" abuse** — registering 68111 with no actual development project is exactly the pattern cited in the Surat Gubernur
- **Hak Milik → HGB conversion** — assuming it's quick; in Bali, BPN processing can take 6–12 months
- **Ignoring the banjar** (local village council) — no government permits will save you if the banjar objects
- **Building first, permitting later** — IMB/PBG enforcement has intensified since 2024, with demolition orders actually executed in Canggu and Pererenan
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 41011 — Construction of the residential buildings (separate KBLI required)
- 68112 — If you'll also rent/lease the properties long-term
- 68210 — If you use brokers/agents to sell
- 71101 — For architectural design services
- 55203 — If units will be rented short-term to tourists (different code entirely)
intel_2026.zantaraOpener: Developing residential property in Bali? 68111 is the #1 PMA code under scrutiny — the Governor wants it closed to new foreign registrations. Let me explain what this means for you.

Many property owners in Bali operate without proper KBLI codes, but enforcement is increasing. If you're a foreign investor building a residential rental portfolio, this code under your PT PMA is the legal path.
