intel_2026.whatItMeans: Managing a tourism zone — organizing and dividing land into sections, building or leasing plots for tourism businesses, and overseeing the development of tourism infrastructure. Think integrated tourism areas: a master developer creates the zone, then individual businesses build within it.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Medium + Large scale only**: High risk (Tinggi) — the highest risk category. NIB + full **Izin** (license, not just a standard certificate) within **14 working days**. Requires Self-Assessment of Standard Readiness, Hygiene Sanitation Feasibility Certificate, and LSPr-certified tourism standard.

**PMA:** Fully open — 100% foreign ownership.

This is serious licensing — High risk means government oversight is intensive.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Renumbered from 68120 in KBLI 2020 (CODICE_RINUMERATO). The old 'Kawasan Pariwisata' code got a new number but keeps the same licensing substance. The 85% match score reflects the renaming.
intel_2026.baliContext: Tourism zone management in Bali is big-league development. Nusa Dua is the original model — BTDC (Bali Tourism Development Corporation) manages the entire zone. Newer developments in Pecatu/Uluwatu and along the Tanah Lot corridor are using similar models. This code is for the zone operator, not individual businesses within the zone. The High risk classification means serious capital requirements and government scrutiny. If you're thinking about this, you're looking at tens of millions in investment minimum. Land rights in tourism zones often use special HGB structures with government cooperation.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:

- 41011 — For construction within the zone
- 55101/55102/55103 — For hotels within the zone
- 79110 — For travel agent services based in the zone

Involves both the development entity (badan usaha pembangunan) and the management entity (badan usaha pengelola).

intel_2026.baliContext: STRATEGICALLY CRITICAL for macro-level investors. Bali has two active SEZs: the Sanur Health SEZ (KEK Sanur) and Kura-Kura Bali. Holding this code unlocks fiscal incentives unavailable to the general market: corporate tax holidays, eased immigration for foreign experts, import duty exemptions. For Zantara users, partnering with a 68123 license holder in Sanur offers a protected investment enclave shielded from the chaotic zoning flux of the general Bali market. However, this is a 'whale' code — relevant only to major consortiums or developers partnering with state-owned enterprises (InJourney, HIN).

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Real estate agents and brokers — intermediating the buying, selling, and renting of property. You connect buyers with sellers or tenants with landlords, earning a fee or commission. This can be done on digital platforms or the traditional way. You don't own the property; you facilitate the deal.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**All scales (Micro through Large)**: Medium-High risk. NIB + Standard Certificate within **3 working days**. Strict requirements:
- Must be a legal entity (badan hukum) registered in Indonesia
- All brokers must be certified property professionals
- Broker supervisors and back-office staff must be certified
- Written agreements with every client

**PMA:** Fully open — 100% foreign ownership.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Direct match from KBLI 2020 (MATCH_LANGSUNG), but the PP28 source code is 68200 — the old general real estate services code. The licensing requirements are substantial for this intermediation role.
intel_2026.baliContext: Bali's property agent market is a Wild West. Hundreds of 'agents' operate without proper licensing, especially in the expat market. Licensed agents are actually the minority. If you want to do this properly as a PT PMA, the broker certification requirement is real — your staff need certified property broker qualifications (from AREBI or equivalent bodies). The 3-day turnaround for the certificate is fast, but getting your brokers certified takes longer. This code covers the booming online property listing businesses too — Bali villa rental platforms, property marketplaces, and the like.

- 68112 — If you manage rental properties directly

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Managing residential real estate on fee/contract basis — supervising and coordinating operations, maintenance, and repairs; collecting rent; preparing budgets; drafting and enforcing rules of conduct for the property.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**ALL scales.** Medium-High. NIB + Standard Certificate. **3-DAY processing** (very fast).

**CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS:** Must be an Indonesian legal entity. ALL property brokers must be WNI (Indonesian nationals). Must have certified experts: at minimum 1 property management and investment expert with Sertifikat Kompetensi Kerja. Must display P4 licensing number visibly. Must report to Ministry of Trade.

**PMA:** Fully open — 100% foreign ownership allowed.
intel_2026.whatChanged: CODICE_RINUMERATO from 68200. Previously a catch-all. Now the 'nominee killer' — any third party managing property MUST hold this code. Foreigners managing properties they don't own without this license risk deportation.
intel_2026.baliContext: THE MOST IMPORTANT REAL ESTATE CODE FOR BALI. This legalizes (and mandates licensing for) the massive villa/property management industry. Hundreds of companies manage properties for absent owners — handling rent collection, maintenance, tenant relations. Under the new enforcement: managing a property you don't own WITHOUT this license = working illegally. For PMA investors, 68292 offers a SCALABLE model: manage hundreds of properties without owning land. CRITICAL: All broker positions must be Indonesian nationals — a foreign owner can be Director but cannot personally act as broker. Compare with 55901 (accommodation management for hospitality operations) — 68292 is for the PROPERTY side, 55901 is for the HOSPITALITY OPERATION side. Smart operators hold both.

- 68210 — Real Estate Brokerage (if also facilitating sales)
- 68111 — Real Estate Owned (if also owning properties)
- 68291 — Property Appraisal (for valuations)

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Advocate activities — representing clients in court, appearing before judges and tribunals, preparing legal pleadings, and providing formal legal defense. This is courtroom lawyering in the traditional sense: litigation, criminal defense, civil lawsuits, arbitration hearings. If someone is standing in front of a judge arguing your case, they're operating under this code.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**WARNING: Effectively CLOSED to foreign investment.** While the KBLI data shows this as TERBUKA 100%, the Advocate Law (UU 18/2003) overrides this. Only Indonesian citizens who are registered members of PERADI (the Indonesian Bar Association) can practice as advocates. No foreign national — regardless of PMA structure — can appear in Indonesian courts.

**All scales (Mikro, Kecil, Menengah, Besar)**: Low risk (Rendah). NIB only, issued **automatically**.

**PMA:** The KBLI technically says open 100%, but this is misleading. Sector-specific legislation closes this to foreigners. Do NOT rely on the KBLI data alone — the Advocate Law is the binding constraint.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Direct match from KBLI 2020 (MATCH_LANGSUNG). The code itself hasn't changed, and neither has the legal reality — Indonesia's advocacy profession has been closed to foreigners since the Advocate Law was enacted in 2003.
intel_2026.baliContext: Foreign investors sometimes see this code's TERBUKA status and get excited. Don't. The Advocate Law is ironclad — no foreign citizen can practice as an advocate in Indonesia, full stop. If you need legal representation in Bali, you hire an Indonesian advocate. If you're a foreign lawyer wanting to work in Indonesia, look at 69102 (Legal Consultant) instead, which allows foreign firms to operate through Technical Assistance Agreements. Several international law firms have Bali-based consultants who advise on cross-border deals — but they cannot step into a courtroom.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 69102 — Legal Consulting (the actual path for foreign legal professionals in Indonesia)
- 69201 — Accounting services (often paired with legal for corporate advisory)
- 70203 — General Management Consulting (if your advice is business strategy, not legal)
intel_2026.zantaraOpener: Interested in 69101 (Advocate)? This one comes with a critical catch — it's technically open in KBLI but effectively closed to foreigners by the Advocate Law. Let me explain.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Legal consulting — providing legal advice, contract drafting, corporate structuring, regulatory compliance guidance, and due diligence. This is the advisory side of law, not the courtroom side. Think corporate lawyers who never see a judge: they review contracts, advise on M&A, draft shareholder agreements, and navigate regulatory approvals.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**All scales (Mikro, Kecil, Menengah, Besar)**: Low risk (Rendah). NIB only, issued **automatically**.

**PMA:** Fully open — 100% foreign ownership allowed. BUT — and this is important — foreign law firms cannot directly practice Indonesian law. You must operate through a Technical Assistance Agreement (TAA) with an Indonesian firm. The TAA structure means you partner with a local firm, provide international expertise, and share work. You can't just hang a shingle and start advising on Indonesian corporate law as a solo foreign entity.

**Source Regulation:** PP 28/2025, Perpres 10/2021, 49/2021, 14/2024.

intel_2026.baliContext: This is the realistic path for foreign legal professionals in Bali. Several international firms have set up advisory operations — typically through TAA partnerships with Jakarta or Denpasar-based Indonesian firms. The work is mostly corporate: helping foreign investors structure PT PMAs, drafting joint venture agreements, navigating BKPM approvals, and handling cross-border commercial contracts. Bali's market is driven by the constant flow of new foreign businesses needing setup advice. If you're a qualified foreign lawyer, this code plus a TAA with a reputable Indonesian firm is your entry point. Denpasar has the most established legal infrastructure, but many consultants work from Canggu or Sanur offices.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Head office and holding company activities — overseeing and managing subsidiary companies, providing strategic direction, corporate governance, and group-level administration. This isn't about running a specific business; it's about running the businesses that run businesses. If you own multiple Indonesian companies and want a single entity to coordinate them, this is your code.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:

**PMA:** Fully open — 100% foreign ownership. PP 28/2025 explicitly recognizes holding company activities as a valid PMA business line. Your equity stakes in subsidiaries count toward the IDR 10 billion investment realization requirement — you don't need to build factories or buy separate assets.

intel_2026.baliContext: This is the sophisticated investor's code. If you own a restaurant under one PT PMA, a villa management company under another, and a consulting firm under a third — you set up a holding company under 70100 to sit on top of all three. Your equity in the subsidiaries counts toward investment realization, which is a major advantage. In Bali, this structure is increasingly common among serial entrepreneurs who've built multiple businesses. The holding company typically sits in Denpasar (where notaries and corporate lawyers are concentrated) even if the operating businesses are in Canggu or Ubud. One catch: the absence of a Large-scale entry is unusual but doesn't block operations — most holding companies comfortably fit within the Medium scale definition.

intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**All scales (Mikro, Kecil, Menengah, Besar)**: Low risk (Rendah). NIB only, issued **automatically**. Unlike 70202 (industrial, Medium-High risk), this catch-all stays Low risk across every scale — even Large.

intel_2026.whatChanged: Direct match from KBLI 2020 (MATCH_LANGSUNG). Unchanged. Note that some activities that were previously under the old 70204 (other management consulting) were absorbed into 70201 during the 2025 revision. What remains in 70209 is the true 'everything else' category.
intel_2026.baliContext: This code is the Swiss Army knife for niche consultants in Bali. Environmental consultants advising on sustainable tourism? 70209. Security consultants working with villa complexes? 70209. Agricultural advisors helping with coffee or cacao operations in the highlands? 70209. It has the same favorable profile as 70203 (Low risk, automatic, 100% PMA) but with the added flexibility of covering areas that don't fit the general business consulting label. In practice, many Bali-based consultants choose between 70203 and 70209 — the difference is semantic rather than regulatory. Use 70209 if your specialty is genuinely niche and you want the code description to match what you actually do.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: This is your code for running an architecture practice — building design, town planning, landscape architecture. It covers the full spectrum from concept sketches to construction documentation. Because buildings involve public safety, this sits at Medium-High risk across all business scales, which means real licensing requirements beyond just your NIB.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**All scales (Mikro through Besar): Medium-High Risk**

You need an NIB plus a Sertifikat Standar (Standard Certificate) with verification. The big requirement here is your SBU (Sertifikat Badan Usaha) issued by an accredited LSBU — this is your company-level construction services license. Your professional staff must hold SKA (Sertifikat Keahlian) or SKK (Sertifikat Kompetensi Kerja) certifications.

For PMA companies, you'll likely need to register as a BUJKA (Badan Usaha Jasa Konstruksi Asing) — the foreign construction services entity framework.

**PMA: 100% foreign ownership allowed.**
intel_2026.whatChanged: Direct match from KBLI 2020 to 2025 — the code and scope remain the same. No structural changes, just the usual periodic review of risk classifications.
intel_2026.baliContext: Bali's building boom in hospitality and villa development means architecture firms stay busy, but local regulations are tightening around building heights, setbacks, and green zone compliance. You'll want staff who understand the Perda for each kabupaten, especially Badung and Gianyar where most development happens. Foreign architects often partner with locally-licensed firms to navigate the permit landscape faster.

Apabila sampai pada akhir masa berlakunya Izin Survei Umum, pemegang Izin tidak memiliki kontrak kerja sama, Izin Survei Umum dinyatakan tidak berlaku dan seluruh data hasil kegiatan Survei Umum wajib diserahkan kepada Pusat Data dan Teknologi Informasi ESDM b. Dalam hal Survei Umum melintasi Wilayah Kerja, Izin Survei Umum yang terdiri dari area di Wilayah Terbuka dan area di Wilayah Kerja yang dilintasi akan dituangkan pada 1 (satu) kontrak kerja sama terkait penyimpanan, pemeliharaan, dan pemasyara katan data antara Pemegang Izin Survei Umum dan Pusat Data dan Teknologi Informasi ESDM c. Kontrak kerja sama dengan Pusat Data dan Teknologi Informasi ESDM dapat dilakukan setelah Izin Survei Umum diterbitkan, dengan tanggal efektif kontrak yaitu sejak memenuhi realisasi luasan area, panjang lintasan, atau jumlah titik Survei Umum minimal 51% (lima puluh satu persen) di Wilayah Terbuka berdasark an hasil pemantauan pelaksanaan Survei Umum oleh Direktorat Jenderal Minyak dan Gas Bumi d. Apabila pemegang Izin Survei Umum tidak melaksanakan kewajiban sebagaimana dimaksud pada angka 2 dan angka 3, data tambahan yang dihasilkan dari perubahan luasan area, panjang lintasan, jumlah titik dan/atau lokasi survei wajib diserahkan kepada Pusat Data dan Teknologi Informasi ESDM setelah dievaluasi oleh Direktorat Jenderal Minyak dan Gas Bumi serta data menjadi milik negara dan pemegang izin tidak memiliki hak pemasyarakatan atas data tambahan

intel_2026.baliContext: Technical certification in Indonesia is accredited through KAN (Komite Akreditasi Nasional) — without KAN accreditation, your certificates have no legal standing. Key certification areas relevant to Bali: SNI product certification (textiles, electronics, food packaging), ISO management system certification (9001, 14001, 45001), and organic certification (SNI 6729:2025). Established certification bodies (BV, SGS, Intertek, TUV) dominate; a new entrant needs full KAN accreditation which takes 2–3 years.

- 71204 — Testing services (often bundled with certification)

Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pembuatan kampanye iklan dan
penempatan iklan, penciptaan identitas merek, pengembangan merek,
pengelolaan kampanye, dan pengembangan materi kreatif iklan,
seperti pada terbitan berkala, koran, surat kabar, radio, televisi,
internet, media digital atau media lainnya untuk konten bidang
keolahragaan maupun bidang lainnya, serta perancangan struktur
lokasi tampilan. Aktivitas periklanan ini umumnya disediakan oleh
biro periklanan dan perwakilan media.
Kelompok ini mencakup:
- pembuatan dan pelaksanaan kampanye iklan pada bidang
keolahragaan dan bidang lainnya, meliputi:
- pembuatan dan penempatan iklan di koran/surat kabar dan
terbitan berkala, di ratdio dan televisi, melalui internet serta media
lainnya;
- pembuatan dan penempatan iklan di luar ruangan, misalnya pada
papan reklame, papan pengumuman, panel, jenis poster dan
gambar, selebaran, pamflet, edaran, brosur dan frame, iklan
jendela, penataan/dekorasi etalase, dan iklan mobil dan bus;
- perwakilan media, yaitu penjualan ruang dan waktu untuk
berbagai macam media untuk penempatan iklan;
- iklan udara (aerial advertising)
- distribusi atau pengiriman materi atau contoh iklan;
- penyediaan ruang iklan pada papan reklame dan sejenisnya;
- pembuatan stan dan struktur pameran serta lokasi iklan lainnya;
- pelaksanaan kampanye pemasaran dan jasa periklanan lainnya
yang ditujukan untuk menarik dan mempertahankan pelanggan
pada bidang keolahragaan dan bidang lainnya, meliputi:
- promosi produk;
- pemasaran di tempat penjualan (point of sale);
- iklan melalui surat langsung (direct mail);
- konsultasi pemasaran sebagai bagian dari periklanan.
Kelompok ini tidak mencakup
- penerbitan materi iklan, lihat subgolongan 5819;
- produksi pesan komersial untuk radio, televisi, dan film, lihat

data.pma_nota: Periklanan

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Advertising Activities — creating advertising campaigns and placing ads across print, digital, outdoor (billboards), TV, and radio. It covers brand identity creation, direct mail marketing, point-of-sale promotions, media representation, and aerial advertising. This is the core code for full-service ad agencies.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Micro, Small, Medium**: Low risk (Rendah). Only an NIB is required, issued **automatically** (Otomatis).

**Large (Besar)**: **No PP28 entry exists** for Large-scale advertising. The regulatory data only covers Mikro/Kecil/Menengah. This may mean Large-scale operations require a separate licensing pathway or are simply not addressed in the current PP28 framework.

**Post-issuance obligations:**
- Submit periodic business activity reports to the Minister of Trade (Menyampaikan laporan kegiatan usaha kepada Menteri Perdagangan)

**Authority:** PP28 specifies "Gubernur Daerah Khusus Jakarta" — for operations outside Jakarta (including Bali), authority defaults to local Bupati/Walikota.

**PMA Status:** RESTRICTED (Terbatas) — **Maximum 49% foreign ownership.** Requires a formal partnership with a domestic business entity (Kemitraan dengan badan usaha dalam negeri).

**Source Regulation:** PP 28/2025, Perpres 10/2021, 49/2021, 14/2024.
intel_2026.whatChanged: MATCH_LANGSUNG. Unchanged from KBLI 2020. The protectionist limits on foreign ownership in media and advertising remain firmly in place.
intel_2026.baliContext: WARNING: This is the most common regulatory trap for digital nomads in Bali. Hundreds of foreigners arrive wanting to open a 'Digital Marketing Agency' or 'Social Media Agency' as a 100% foreign-owned PT PMA. You CANNOT do this under 73100. Advertising is strictly capped at 49% foreign ownership, meaning you must have an Indonesian corporate partner holding the majority share. To bypass this, smart foreign founders pivot their business models. Instead of 'Advertising,' they classify their business as 'Management Consulting' (70209) or the new 'Graphic Design' (74192) code, which are 100% open. If you use those workarounds, ensure you do not explicitly buy media (like billboard space or Facebook Ads) on behalf of clients.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 70209 — Management Consulting (the standard 100% PMA alternative for marketing strategists)
- 74192 — Graphic Design (if your agency focuses purely on the visual/creative asset side)
- 74209 — Photography Services (essential for content creation agencies)
intel_2026.zantaraOpener: Planning to start a digital marketing agency in Bali? Be very careful—KBLI 73100 is capped at 49% foreign ownership, so you might need to pivot your KBLI strategy.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Market research — consumer behavior studies, market potential analysis, product acceptance testing, competitive landscape mapping. This is the analytical side of marketing: gathering data about what people want, how they buy, and what they'll pay. Distinct from opinion polling (73202), which focuses on public sentiment rather than commercial insight.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**All scales (Mikro through Besar): Low Risk (Rendah)**

NIB only — no additional licenses, no Sertifikat Standar, no sector-specific permits. Register and operate.

**PMA: 100% foreign ownership allowed.**
intel_2026.whatChanged: Direct match from KBLI 2020 to 2025. No changes in code, scope, or risk classification. Market research remains one of the cleanest, lowest-friction professional services codes available.
intel_2026.baliContext: Bali's unique position as both a tourism economy and a growing digital hub creates interesting market research opportunities. Understanding spending patterns of 5+ million annual tourists, mapping the co-working and co-living market, or analyzing F&B preferences across visitor demographics — all solid business cases. Many research firms base here for lifestyle while serving Jakarta-headquartered clients remotely.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 73202 — Public Opinion Polling (if research extends into social/political sentiment)
- 73100 — Advertising (if offering research as part of full-service marketing)
- 62199 — Software Development (if building proprietary research platforms)
- 70203 — Management Consulting (if market research feeds into strategic advisory)
intel_2026.zantaraOpener: Market research is one of the easiest professional services to set up in Indonesia — low risk, fully open to PMA, NIB and you're done.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Public opinion polling — surveys on political sentiment, economic confidence, social attitudes, and public policy issues. Think election polling, government approval ratings, and social trend tracking. While it shares methodology with market research, the subject matter is public opinion rather than commercial behavior, and that distinction matters more than you might expect.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**All scales (Mikro through Besar): Low Risk (Rendah)**

Technically, it's NIB only — same low-risk classification as market research.

**However:** Political polling during election cycles faces heightened scrutiny, particularly around foreign funding and influence. While OSS treats this as standard low-risk, in practice you may encounter informal pushback from local authorities if your polling touches sensitive political topics.

**PMA: 100% foreign ownership allowed.**
intel_2026.whatChanged: Direct match from KBLI 2020 to 2025. No changes to code, scope, or risk classification. The regulatory environment around polling itself continues to evolve with each election cycle.
intel_2026.baliContext: Bali-based opinion polling is uncommon — most polling firms operate from Jakarta. If you're setting up here, you're likely running a distributed research operation headquartered in Bali. For tourism-focused opinion research (visitor satisfaction, community attitudes toward development), Bali makes perfect sense as a base.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 73201 — Market Research (the commercial counterpart — most firms hold both codes)
- 70203 — Management Consulting (if polling data feeds into advisory services)
- 63101 — Data Processing & Hosting (if running your own data infrastructure)
- 62199 — Software Development (if building proprietary polling platforms)
intel_2026.zantaraOpener: Opinion polling is technically low-risk and fully open to PMA, but there are practical sensitivities around political polling that we should discuss.

persyaratan: Standar Penetapan Kemampuan Badan Usaha Jasa Konstruksi / Sertifikat Badan Usaha (SBU) Subklasifikasi: AR003

Untuk Kantor Perwakilan BUJKA: a. Merupakan badan usaha jasa konstruksi berbadan hukum di negara asal b. Membayar biaya administrasi perizinan berusaha per jenis usaha sesuai peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku

Untuk BUJK PMA: a. Penanam modal asing/ pemegang saham asing merupakan badan usaha jasa konstruksi berbadan hukum di negara asal yang dibuktikan dengan: 1) Akta pendirian yang dilegalisasi 2) Sertifikat perizinan bidang usaha jasa konstruksi berkualifikasi Besar di negara asal atau yang sejenis yang dilegalisasi b. Penanam modal dalam negeri/ pemegang saham dalam negeri merupakan badan usaha jasa konstruksi nasional berkualifikasi Besar yang dibuktikan dengan: 1) Perizinan berusaha subsektor jasa konstruksi 2) Sertifikat Badan Usaha subsektor jasa konstruksi
kewajiban: Menyampaikan Laporan Kegiatan Usaha Tahunan
SBU masih berlaku
Melaksanakan ketentuan dalam peraturan perundang-undangan di bidang jasa konstruksi

Untuk Kantor Perwakilan BUJKA: a. Melakukan perpanjangan Sertifikat Standar sesuai subklasifikasi setiap 3 tahun b. Melakukan Kerja Sama Operasi (KSO) dengan BUJKN berkualifikasi Besar dan memiliki klasifikasi/ subklasifikasi sejenis yang tercatat di lembaga pengembangan jasa konstruksi sebelum mengikuti proses pemilihan c. KSO untuk pelaksanaan Jasa Konsultansi Konstruksi dilaksanakan dengan ketentuan kriteria teknis KSO sebagai berikut: 1) Seluruh pekerjaan jasa Konsultansi Konstruksi dilakukan di dalam negeri 2) Paling sedikit 50% (lima puluh persen) dari nilai pekerjaan jasa Konsultansi Konstruksi dikerjakan oleh BUJKN mitra KSO

Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan penyediaan jasa konsultasi desain
interior/desain ruang dalam, yaitu merencanakan/merancang ruang
dalam atau interior dari bangunan atau gedung berdasarkan kegiatan
manusia, fungsi ruangan dan untuk mendapatkan hasil
suasana/atmosfer dengan mempertimbangkan unsur -unsur:
keamanan, kesehatan, keselamatan, kenyamanan, penunjang
penderita disabilitas, dan estetika. Dalam bidang desain interior,
selain jasa perencanaan, kegiatan ini juga mencakup jasa survei, jasa
studi kelayakan, jasa drafting, jasa desain artist impression, jasa
supervisi/pengawasan interior bangunan/gedung, jasa estimasi
harga/QS, dan jasa manajemen proyek di dalam konstruksi
perencanaan desain interior, termasuk desain interior pada bangunan
gedung maupun bangunan sipil lainnya.
Kelompok ini tidak mencakup
- aktivitas arsitektural, lihat kelompok 71101.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Interior design — planning and designing the inside of buildings and rooms based on human activities, room function, and desired atmosphere. Considering aesthetics, materials, textures, lighting, color, and furniture to create functional and beautiful spaces. This covers residential interiors, commercial spaces, hospitality design, and everything in between.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Brand new code (BPS_ONLY)** — no PP28/2025 licensing data published yet. The risk category and specific requirements are pending. NIB required at minimum.

**PMA:** Fully open — 100% foreign ownership.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Completely new code in KBLI 2025 (BPS_ONLY). In the 2020 classification, interior design was bundled into broader design categories. The 2025 overhaul created specific codes for each design discipline: industrial design (74111-74119), interior design (74191), graphic design (74192), film/video design (74193), game design (74194), and others. Interior design finally has its own dedicated code.
intel_2026.baliContext: Bali has a thriving interior design scene — driven by the constant pipeline of new villas, hotels, restaurants, and boutique spaces. The 'Bali style' (tropical modern, open-air, natural materials) is exported worldwide. Many international interior designers have set up studios in Bali, particularly in Seminyak and Canggu. The market ranges from budget villa fit-outs (IDR 200-500M) to ultra-luxury resort interiors (billions). Since this is a BPS_ONLY code with no PP28 data yet, licensing requirements are minimal for now — just NIB. Local craftsmen (stone carvers, woodworkers, furniture makers in Gianyar and Klungkung) are a major resource that makes Bali competitive for interior design globally.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:

This code is marked **BPS_ONLY**. It is a new specialized classification in KBLI 2025 and currently has no PP28/2025 licensing data mapped in the OSS system. Specific risk levels and requirements will be published when OSS fully integrates KBLI 2025.

intel_2026.baliContext: This code is a massive win for Bali's creative expat community. Thousands of freelance graphic designers, branding experts, and UI/UX artists operate out of cafes in Canggu and Ubud. Previously, it was legally dangerous to classify a pure design studio without falling into the heavily restricted Advertising (73100) code. KBLI 74192 provides a clean, 100% PMA-open avenue to set up a legal entity, bill international clients, and sponsor your own Investor KITAS. You don't need a physical studio; a virtual office is perfectly fine. Ensure your client contracts state 'design deliverables' rather than 'ad placements' to stay compliant.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Patent brokerage — intermediating the buying, selling, and licensing of patents and intellectual property rights. Acting as a broker or agent between patent holders and companies seeking to acquire or license patented technologies. Not the creation of IP (which is R&D) but the commercial transaction of existing IP.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**All scales (Mikro/Kecil/Menengah/Besar)**: Medium-Low risk (Menengah Rendah). NIB + Standard Certificate issued automatically.

**PMA:** Fully open — 100% foreign ownership.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Renumbered in KBLI 2025 (CODICE_RINUMERATO). The activity existed under a different code number in 2020 — the scope is the same but the code changed. Update your NIB before the June 2026 deadline.
intel_2026.baliContext: Niche but growing in Indonesia as the startup ecosystem matures. Bali-based companies occasionally need patent brokerage for technology licensing (particularly in wellness tech, sustainable energy, and agritech). The more practical Bali use case: foreign entrepreneurs who hold patents in their home countries and want to license them to Indonesian companies through a local PMA entity. The IP brokerage market in Indonesia is still developing — Jakarta dominates, but having a Bali-registered entity with international IP expertise can serve the growing tech hub in Canggu and beyond.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 77400 — If you also lease/license IP (not just broker transactions)
- 69200 — If you provide IP-related accounting/advisory services
- 70201 — If you offer broader business consulting alongside IP brokerage
- 62199 — If you deal specifically with software patents and tech licensing

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Recreational and sports equipment rental — operational leasing (rental without option to buy) of surfboards, bicycles, kayaks, camping gear, fitness equipment, and other recreational gear. You rent it out, the customer uses it, they bring it back. No purchase option involved.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Risk: Rendah (Low)** across all scales. Only NIB required, automatic issuance. Important distinction: this covers operational leasing only. Financial leasing (with purchase option) is regulated by OJK (Financial Services Authority) and requires a completely different licensing framework.

**PMA:** Fully open (TERBUKA), 100% foreign ownership allowed.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Aggregated from KBLI 2020 codes (MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE) — combines 77210 with PP28 code 77220.
intel_2026.baliContext: Surfboard rental in Kuta and Canggu, bicycle rental in Ubud, kayak rental in Sanur — this is a tourism-adjacent business that's relatively easy to set up compared to more heavily regulated sectors. The capital requirements are manageable, the equipment is the main asset, and the market is steady as long as tourists keep coming. Many operators combine this with other tourism codes (93295 for beach, 93297 for water sports). Insurance for equipment damage and customer injury is strongly recommended even if not strictly mandated for all equipment types.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 77291 — If also renting other recreational equipment not covered here
- 93295 — If operating from a beach area
- 93297 — If the rental is part of a water tourism operation
- 79121 — If packaging equipment rental as part of tour packages
intel_2026.zantaraOpener: Starting a surfboard, bicycle, or sports equipment rental in Bali? 77210 covers recreational equipment rental — a straightforward tourism-adjacent business.

barang keperluan rumah tangga (selain peralatan rekreasi dan

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Rental and leasing of water transport vessels — renting boats, yachts, speedboats, jet skis, and other watercraft to businesses or individuals without a crew (bare boat charter). The lessee operates the vessel themselves.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Micro scale**: Low risk. NIB only — issued automatically.


**PMA:** Fully open to PMA — 100% foreign ownership allowed.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Unchanged from KBLI 2020 — direct match.
intel_2026.baliContext: Yacht and speedboat bare-boat charter is a niche business in Bali — the Benoa Marina and Serangan Marina are the main bases. KSOP Denpasar regulates vessel operation and charter businesses. Bare boat charter customers need their own skipper license (Sertifikat Keahlian Pelaut from DKHUB). Most tourists prefer crewed charters (which falls under 50113). Jet ski rental on Bali's beaches (Tanjung Benoa is the hub) is a regulated activity requiring environmental compliance permits.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 50113 — If you provide crewed tourist transport
- KSOP vessel permits — required for all charter vessels

tidak berstatus sebagai pegawai dari perusahaan penempatan ten aga

Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pendaftaran, penyeleksian,
penempatan, serta perlindungan tenaga kerja untuk kegiatan rumah
tangga sebagai pemberi kerja di dalam negeri, seperti penempatan
asisten rumah tangga, pengasuh balita, perawat nonmedis lansia, dan
sopir pribadi berbagai jenis posisi lainnya dalam rumah tangga. Dalam

pegawai dari perusahaan penempatan tenaga kerja. Kelompok ini
tidak mencakup kegiatan penempatan perawat bayi dan peng asuh
anak yang tenaga kerjanya berstatus sebagai pegawai dari perusahaan
penempatan tenaga kerja, lihat kelompok 78200.

data.judul: AKTIVITAS PENYEDIAAN TENAGA KERJA SEMENTARA DAN
data.uraian:
PENYEDIAAN SUMBER DAYA MANUSIA LAINNYA
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan penyediaan pekerja untuk usaha
klien selama periode waktu tertentu, baik untuk menggantikan
sementara maupun menambah tenaga kerja klien. Dalam perjanjian
kerja tersebut, agen ketenagakerjaan sementara atau penyedia
sumber daya manusia adalah pemberi kerja dari pekerja individu yang
dipekerjakan. Namun, klien bertanggung jawab atas pengawasan
personel sementara. Kegiatan yang diklasifikasikan di sini tidak
menyediakan pengawas langsung untuk pekerja yang ditempatkan
pada pemberi kerja.
Unit yang diklasifikasikan dalam kelompok ini mewakili pemberi kerja
resmi untuk karyawan dalam hal -hal yang berkaitan dengan
penggajian, pajak, dan masalah fiskal dan sumber daya manusia
lainnya, tetapi tidak bertanggung jawab langsung atas pengawasan
karyawan. Unit yang diklasifikasikan dalam kelompok ini melakukan
berbagai tugas manajemen sumber daya manusia dan personel yang
terkait dengan ketentuan ini.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan jasa manajemen sumber daya
manusia untuk pemberi kerja. Kegiatan ini dikhususkan untuk
menyelenggarakan sumber daya manusia dan tugas manajemen
personel. Kegiatan ini menyajikan riwayat kerja pekerja dalam hal
yang berhubungan dengan upah, pajak dan masalah keuangan dan
sumber daya lainnya termasuk penyedia jasa pekerja/buruh.
Kelompok ini juga mencakup kegiatan penempatan perawat bayi (baby
sitter) dan pengasuh anak yang dipekerjakan oleh penyedia tenaga
kerja, sedangkan perawat bayi (baby sitter) dan pengasuh anak yang
dipekerjakan oleh majikan langsung masuk di subgolongan 7810.
Kelompok ini tidak mencakup kegiatan layanan penagihan, lihat

Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan perantara penjualan paket
perjalanan wisata atau untuk tujuan lainnya seperti tur atau
perjalanan ibadah, baik secara daring maupun luring, yang dikemas
oleh biro perjalanan dalam partai besar atau eceran pada masyarakat
umum dan klien komersial,
Kelompok ini juga mencakup
- kegiatan perantara penjualan paket ibadah umrah dan haji
khusus, baik secara daring maupun luring, yang dikemas oleh biro
perjalanan ibadah umrah dan haji khusus;
- kegiatan perantara penjualan paket perjalanan wisata olahraga
yang mencakup berbagai bentuk perjalanan dan pengalaman yang
melibatkan kegiatan fisik, kompetisi, atau hiburan berbasis
olahraga, seperti perjalanan untuk acara olahraga, wisata olahraga
petualangan, dan perjalanan khusus untuk atlet dan tim olahraga
yang akan bertanding;
- kegiatan intermediasi dalam penyelesaian kontrak penyediaan
jasa wisata dari biro perjalanan;
- jasa intermediasi paket perjalanan di destinasi.

data.judul: AKTIVITAS BIRO PERJALANAN IBADAH UMRAH DAN HAJI KHUSUS
data.uraian:
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas biro perjalanan yang melakukan
perencanaan dan penyusunan paket perjalanan ibadah umrah dan
haji khusus dengan cara menyalurkan melalui agen perjalanan dan
atau menjual langsung kepada konsumen. Kegiatan ini mencakup
penyediaan layanan yang berhubungan dengan paket ibadah umrah
dan haji khusus yang dijual, baik secara daring maupun luring;
penyediaan layanan angkutan, akomodasi, makanan; serta
pengurusan dokumen perjalanan berupa paspor dan visa atau
dokumen lain yang dipersamakan.

data.uraian:
Kelompok ini mencakup:
- kegiatan penanaman, perawatan dan pemeliharaan taman dan
kebun untuk perumahan pribadi dan umum, bangunan publik
dan semipublik (sekolah, rumah sakit, lembaga pemerintah,
tempat ibadah, dan lain -lain), kawasan perkotaan (taman,
kawasan penghijauan, pemakaman atau kuburan, dan lain -lain),
jalur hijau jalan bebas hambatan (jalan, jalur kereta, jalur
angkutan air), serta bangunan industri dan komersial;
- penanaman, perawatan, dan pemeliharaan tanaman untuk
bangunan (kebun di atas atap, penghijauan depan bangunan,
tanaman dalam ruangan, dll), taman olahraga, taman bermain dan
taman rekreasi lainnya (lapangan olahraga, bermain, berjemur dan
golf), serta tempat air tenang dan mengalir (kolam, kolam renang,
selokan, anak sungai, sistem saluran pembuangan);
- penanaman vegetasi tanaman untuk perlindungan terhadap suara
atau keributan, angin, erosi, jarak pandang, dan panas atau silau
matahari;
- perlindungan dan pemulihan lanskap, misalnya untuk taman dan
kebun;
- pekerjaan rekayasa ekologi untuk tujuan pelestarian ekologi suatu
tempat.
Kelompok ini juga mencakup
- kegiatan yang berkaitan dengan perawatan pohon amenitas dan
arborikultur, restorasi lingkungan alami, misalnya rekayasa
tanaman dan renaturasi ekosistem;
- kegiatan pengendalian erosi lingkungan pegunungan, tempat
pemijahan, dan tepian sungai;
- pembuatan dan relokasi habitat spesies, misalnya kotak
bersarang, tempat berteduh, dan hibernacula;
- kegiatan pencegahan, pengendalian, dan respons terhadap
introduksi dan penyebaran spesies invasif, baik fauna atau flora;
- pengelolaan lingkungan, misalnya melakukan tindakan
perlindungan dan pemeliharaan untuk bukit pasir, lahan basah,
lahan basah, atau area sensitif lainnya; penggembalaan ekologis;
dll.
Kelompok ini tidak mencakup
- kegiatan perlindungan atau restorasi lahan pertanian dan hutan,

data.uraian:
SELAIN INTERMEDIASI FINANSIAL
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas jasa intermediasi untuk aktivitas
penunjang usaha yang tidak tercantum di tempat lain. Kelompok ini
mencakup unit yang mempertemukan klien dan penyedia layanan
atas dasar balas jasa atau kontrak.
Aktivitas intermediasi ini dapat dilakukan melalui platform digital
atau melalui saluran nondigital (tatap muka, pintu ke pintu, telepon,
surat, dll.). Balas jasa atau komisi dapat diterima dari klien atau
penyedia layanan. Pendapatan untuk aktivitas inter mediasi dapat
mencakup sumber pendapatan lain, seperti pendapatan dari iklan.
Kelompok ini juga mencakup
- kegiatan reservasi dan penjualan tiket untuk acara teater,
olahraga, dan hiburan lainnya.
Kelompok ini tidak mencakup
- kegiatan pialang dan agen untuk tenaga listrik dan gas alam, lihat

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Private kindergarten — formal early childhood education for ages 4-6, emphasizing holistic child development through play-based learning. Priority enrollment is ages 5-6. This covers private (swasta) kindergartens specifically, not government-run ones.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**BPS_ONLY** — no PP28/2025 licensing data exists yet. Education is heavily regulated through separate ministry channels (Dinas Pendidikan), so licensing comes through education-specific pathways rather than the standard OSS risk framework.

**PMA:** Foreign ownership capped at 49-51% depending on bilateral agreements. You CANNOT operate via a standard PT PMA — you must use a Yayasan (Foundation) structure. International schools use the SPK (Satuan Pendidikan Kerjasama) framework, which has its own approval process through the Ministry of Education.
intel_2026.whatChanged: BPS_ONLY — this code appears in BPS classification data but has no PP28/2025 licensing framework yet. Private kindergarten licensing is handled through education-specific channels (Dinas Pendidikan), not the standard OSS risk framework.
intel_2026.baliContext: Growing demand from expat families with young children, especially in Ubud, Sanur, and Canggu where international kindergartens have been popping up. The Yayasan structure is fundamentally different from a profit-generating PT PMA — it's a non-profit foundation, and that changes everything about how money flows. Many foreign educators get tripped up by this: you can't just set up a PT PMA and call it a school. The SPK framework adds another layer of approval that takes 6-12 months minimum.

- 85593 — If providing language courses as enrichment

This covers undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs. The institution must be accredited by BAN-PT (National Higher Education Accreditation Board) and approved by Kemendikbud (Ministry of Education, Culture, Research and Technology).
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**All scales: High Risk (Tinggi)**
This is one of the heaviest licensing paths in the entire KBLI system. NIB + Izin (permit-based licensing). You need full Kemendikbud accreditation, which involves institutional review, faculty qualifications, curriculum approval, and facility inspections. The approval process can take 12-24 months.

**PMA:** Fully open — 100% foreign ownership allowed. But in practice, foreign universities typically partner with Indonesian foundations (yayasan) to navigate the regulatory landscape.

High risk at ALL scales — there is no “easy” entry point here.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Renumbered in KBLI 2025 (CODICE_RINUMERATO). The code was restructured from the 2020 classification but the regulatory substance is the same: private higher education remains one of the most heavily regulated business activities in Indonesia.
intel_2026.baliContext: Bali has a growing higher education scene beyond Udayana University (the main public institution). International programs, satellite campuses of Jakarta universities, and specialized institutions are appearing — particularly in Denpasar and Jimbaran. The opportunity for foreign investment lies in niche programs: hospitality management (given Bali's tourism economy), creative arts, sustainable development, and international business. Partnerships with established Indonesian universities (Udayana spinoffs, Warmadewa, STIKOM Bali) are the pragmatic entry path rather than building from scratch. The accreditation timeline alone makes this a long-term investment play.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Sports and Recreation Education — organizing non-degree training and camps in sports and recreational activities. This explicitly includes surf schools, yoga teacher training, martial arts dojos, equestrian training, swimming, and e-sports coaching led by professional instructors.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
This code is marked **BPS_ONLY**. It is a new KBLI 2025 classification with no PP28/2025 licensing data attached in OSS yet. Licensing risk and specific post-issuance obligations will be defined when KBLI 2025 officially goes live in the OSS system.

**PMA Status:** Fully open (Terbuka) — 100% foreign ownership allowed under non-formal education guidelines.
intel_2026.whatChanged: BPS_ONLY. This brings immense clarity to KBLI 2025 by consolidating surf schools, yoga teacher trainings (YTTs), and martial arts into one clean educational code.
intel_2026.baliContext: This is the holy grail code for Bali's massive wellness and surf industries. Every Yoga Teacher Training (YTT) in Ubud and Surf School in Uluwatu will operate under this classification. It is a highly lucrative, high-margin business, completely open to foreign ownership. However, the true trap here isn't the corporate license—it's immigration and manpower laws. If you open a PT PMA under 85510 and hire foreign yoga teachers or surf coaches, they MUST possess a valid Working KITAS with a proper IMTA (work permit) declaring them as 'Master Trainers'. Bali Immigration regularly raids yoga studios and surf camps for foreigners 'teaching' on tourist or investor visas.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Private hospitals — full-service medical facilities operated by private entities. This covers inpatient and outpatient care, surgical services, emergency departments, diagnostic services, and specialist medical treatment. The hospital must meet Ministry of Health standards for staffing, equipment, and facilities.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Besar (Large) scale only: High Risk (Tinggi)**
NIB + Izin (permit-based licensing). Full accreditation required from KARS (Komisi Akreditasi Rumah Sakit — Hospital Accreditation Commission). You need SIP (Surat Izin Praktik / Practice License) for the institution, STR (Surat Tanda Registrasi / Registration Certificate) for all medical practitioners, and operational permits from the provincial health department.

Only listed at Besar scale in the data — running a hospital is inherently a large-scale operation.

**PMA:** Fully open — 100% foreign ownership allowed. But foreign-owned hospitals must meet minimum capital requirements and demonstrate medical expertise.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Direct match from KBLI 2020 (MATCH_LANGSUNG). Private hospitals have had a stable classification across both versions. The licensing requirements remain among the most stringent in the system.
intel_2026.baliContext: Bali's private hospital scene is established: BIMC (Kuta and Nusa Dua), Siloam (Kuta), Kasih Ibu (Denpasar and Tabanan), BaliMed, and Prima Medika serve both locals and medical tourists. The opportunity for new entrants lies in specialized facilities — rehabilitation centers, mental health clinics, fertility clinics, and wellness-medical hybrid facilities. Medical tourism is growing: Australian and Asian patients come for dental work, cosmetic surgery, and wellness treatments at a fraction of home-country prices. The accreditation process through KARS takes 12-18 months minimum. Location matters enormously — proximity to tourist areas for medical tourism, or underserved areas like Karangasem and Buleleng for gap-filling.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 86105 — If you also operate satellite clinics
- 86202 — If your hospital houses specialist practices
- 86203 — If you have a dental department
- 86993 — If you run diagnostic labs or health support services
- 47252 — If you have an in-hospital pharmacy

intel_2026.whatItMeans: General medical practitioner — individual doctor's practice providing primary healthcare, consultations, check-ups, and basic medical treatment. This is the family doctor / GP model. The practitioner sees patients, diagnoses common conditions, prescribes medication, and refers to specialists when needed.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**All scales: Medium-High risk (Menengah Tinggi)**
NIB + Sertifikat Standar within **14 working days**. Requires SIP (Surat Izin Praktik / Practice License) and STR (Surat Tanda Registrasi / Registration Certificate) from the Indonesian Medical Council (KKI).

**PMA:** Fully open — 100% foreign ownership. Foreign doctors must have their credentials validated by KKI and meet Indonesian medical practice requirements.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Direct match from KBLI 2020 (MATCH_LANGSUNG). General practitioner practice classification unchanged between versions.
intel_2026.baliContext: GP practices in Bali serve both the local population and the growing expat/digital nomad community. There's a gap in English-speaking general practice — most international-facing medical care is hospital-based (BIMC, Siloam). A standalone GP practice targeting the expat community in Canggu, Ubud, or Sanur could fill this gap. The challenge: foreign doctors must navigate KKI credential validation, which can take 6-12 months. Many foreign medical professionals choose to partner with an Indonesian doctor who holds the SIP while they provide consultancy or specialized expertise.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Health intermediation — platform businesses that connect patients with healthcare providers. Telemedicine platforms, doctor appointment booking services, medical referral networks, health insurance intermediaries. You don't provide medical care; you facilitate access to it.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Brand new code (BPS_ONLY)** — no PP28/2025 licensing data exists yet. The specific risk category, requirements, and licensing pathway haven't been formally published. You'll need NIB at minimum, and should monitor OSS for when licensing details are added.

**PMA:** Fully open — 100% foreign ownership.
intel_2026.whatChanged: This is a completely new code in KBLI 2025 — it didn't exist in 2020 (BPS_ONLY status). Created to capture the rapidly growing health-tech and telemedicine market. Previously, health platforms were shoehorned into generic IT or healthcare codes.
intel_2026.baliContext: Bali's fragmented healthcare landscape creates a real need for health intermediation. Tourists and expats struggle to find the right doctor, clinic, or specialist — especially outside the Kuta-Seminyak-Sanur corridor. A platform connecting patients with verified healthcare providers, facilitating appointments, and handling medical tourism logistics could tap a large market. Existing players like Halodoc and Alodokter serve the national market; there's room for a Bali-specific service targeting the international community. Since there's no PP28 data yet, this is a low-friction entry — build the platform, establish the network, and be ready when full licensing requirements are published.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 62199 — If you're building the tech platform yourself
- 63120 — If you operate a web portal
- 86105 — If you also operate a clinic alongside the platform
- 65200 — If you intermediate health insurance

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Traditional health services — healthcare rooted in traditional, complementary, or alternative medicine. This covers jamu (traditional herbal medicine), acupuncture, traditional Chinese medicine, Ayurveda, traditional Balinese healing (Balian), reflexology, and other non-Western health practices recognized by the Indonesian health system.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**All scales: Medium-High risk (Menengah Tinggi)**
NIB + Sertifikat Standar within **14 working days**. Traditional health practitioners need STPT (Surat Tanda Pendaftaran Tenaga Kesehatan Tradisional — Traditional Health Practitioner Registration Certificate) from the local health department.

**PMA:** Fully open — 100% foreign ownership.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Direct match from KBLI 2020 (MATCH_LANGSUNG). Traditional health services classification unchanged.
intel_2026.baliContext: This is where traditional Bali meets the modern wellness economy. Balian (traditional Balinese healers) are cultural treasures — some have been treating locals and tourists for decades. The wellness tourism trend has created a market for 'authentic healing experiences': Balinese massage with spiritual components, jamu preparations, sound healing, energy work. Ubud is the epicenter — it's practically become a global wellness pilgrimage destination. The business opportunity: packaging traditional Balinese wellness for international audiences, combining Balian wisdom with modern health standards. Be respectful — this sits at the intersection of business and Balinese Hindu culture. Working with local healers as partners rather than employees is culturally appropriate.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Massage parlours — establishments primarily offering massage services for relaxation and wellness. This is distinct from medical massage (which falls under paramedical services 86991) and spa treatments (which fall under 96230). Think traditional massage houses, reflexology centers, and standalone massage businesses.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Brand new code (BPS_ONLY)** — no PP28/2025 licensing data exists yet. The specific risk category, requirements, and licensing pathway haven't been formally published. You'll need NIB at minimum, and should monitor OSS for when licensing details are added.

**PMA:** Fully open — 100% foreign ownership.
intel_2026.whatChanged: This is a completely new code in KBLI 2025 — it didn't exist in 2020 (BPS_ONLY status). Previously, massage parlours were lumped into broader personal service or health codes. The 2025 classification recognizes massage as a distinct business activity, separating it from spas, wellness centers, and medical services.
intel_2026.baliContext: Massage is the backbone of Bali's wellness industry. From IDR 80,000/hour Balinese massage in a Kuta side street to IDR 800,000 luxury treatments in a Seminyak spa resort, massage is everywhere. The code specifically covers rumah pijat (massage houses) — standalone massage businesses that aren't full-service spas. This is the most accessible entry point into Bali's wellness economy: lower setup costs than a spa, simpler operations, massive demand from tourists. Ubud, Sanur, and Canggu all have thriving massage business clusters. Since there's no PP28 data yet, licensing is currently minimal — get your NIB early and establish your reputation.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 96230 — If you also offer beauty/spa treatments beyond massage
- 86992 — If you incorporate traditional health practices
- 86991 — If you offer medical/therapeutic massage
- 85573 — If you also train massage therapists
intel_2026.zantaraOpener: Opening a massage business in Bali? 86995 is a brand-new 2025 code for rumah pijat — no PP28 data yet, which means minimal friction to get started.

residensial, dengan bantuan, medis, perawatan keperawatan, dan
rehabilitasi yang dilakukan oleh pemerintah. Fasilitas ini memiliki staf
inti tetap yang terdiri dari perawat praktik terdaftar ata u berlisensi

data.judul: AKTIVITAS LEMBAGA KESEJAHTERAAN SOSIAL ANAK BERBASIS
data.uraian:
RESIDENSIAL
Kelompok ini mencakup penyediaan jasa sosial berbasis residensial
dan layanan perawatan dan pengasuhan anak yang dilakukan oleh
Lembaga Kesejahteraan Sosial (LKS) anak. Kelompok ini mencakup
kegiatan penyediaan tempat sementara dan pendampingan sosial
yang diberikan sepanjang waktu kepada anak yang memerlukan
perlindungan khusus yang tidak membutuhkan pelayanan kesehatan
dan pendidikan sebagai layanan yang utama, seperti panti asuhan,
asrama anak, rumah singgah sementara dan lembaga yang
memberikan perlindu ngan dan dukungan keluarga berbasis
residensial lainnya. Kelompok ini juga mencakup kegiatan residensial
dalam bentuk rehabilitasi sosial untuk orang yang mengalami
disfungsi sosial, kegiatan yang mendukung proses reintegrasi sosial
untuk orang yang mengal ami disfungsi sosial, dan lembaga
penyelanggara kesejahteraan sosial anak.

data.judul: AKTIVITAS PERAWATANUNTUK ANAK YANG BERHADAPAN DENGAN
data.uraian:
HUKUM BERBASIS RESIDENSIAL

dan layanan perawatan dan bantuan hukum. Kegiatan ini dapat
dilakukan oleh pemerintah atau pihak swasta. Kelompok ini
mencakup kegiatan bantuan hukum dan sosial yang diberikan kepada
anak da lam tiga kategori (pelaku, korban, dan saksi. Kelompok ini
juga mencakup kegiatan rumah kelompok rehabilitasi untuk orang
yang mempunyai masalah sosial dan pribadi, kegiatan rumah
kelompok rehabilitasi untuk orang yang mempunyai kecenderungan
kriminal, dan rumah perlindungan sosial.

Kelompok ini mencakup penyediaan jasa berbasis residensial dan
layanan perawatan dan bantuan di tempat tinggal bagi tunasusila, eks
napi, gelandangan dan pengemis, korban tindak pidana perdagangan
orang. Kegiatan ini dapat dilakukan oleh pemerintah atau pi hak
lembaga kesejahteraan sosial (LKS).
Kelompok ini juga mencakup kegiatan bantuan sosial berupa selter
yang diberikan dalam kurun waktu tertentu; penyediaan bantuan
sosial bagi tunasosial, pengungsi, dan imigran; kegiatan rumah
kelompok rehabilitasi untuk orang yang mempunyai masalah sosial
dan pribadi; dan kegiatan penunjang keluarga residensial lainnya.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Visual arts creation — the creation of original visual artworks. Painting, sculpture, drawing, printmaking, ceramic art, installation art, digital art, mixed media. This code covers the artist as creator, not the gallery that sells the work or the venue that displays it. If you make visual art, this is your code.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**All scales (Mikro/Kecil/Menengah/Besar): Low Risk (Rendah)**
NIB only — no Standard Certificate or special permits needed at any scale. One of the simplest codes in the entire system.

**PMA:** Fully open — 100% foreign ownership.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Consolidated from multiple 2020 art codes (MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE). The 2025 system merged various visual art subcategories into a single, cleaner 90120 code. Simpler classification, same creative freedom.
intel_2026.baliContext: Ubud is the undisputed art capital of Bali — and one of the most important art communities in Southeast Asia. The legacy of Walter Spies, Arie Smit, and the Young Artists movement created a tradition that continues today. Dozens of galleries line Jl. Raya Ubud and Jl. Hanoman. For foreign artists, Bali offers an inspiring environment and low cost of living, but the commercial art market is competitive. The opportunity: contemporary art that bridges Balinese traditions with international aesthetics, digital art and NFT creation (Bali has a growing Web3 community), and art residency programs that combine creation with education (link to 85573). Low Risk at all scales means minimal bureaucracy — focus on making art, not paperwork.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:

- 90391 — If you organize art events, exhibitions, or festivals
- 85573 — If you teach art workshops alongside creating
- 47593 — If you sell art supplies or materials
- 90200 — If your work includes performance elements

Balinese painting (wayang-style, Young Artists movement), woodcarving, stonework, and silver art are globally traded. UU Hak Cipta 28/2014 provides automatic copyright protection for original artworks. Export of artworks valued above certain thresholds may require cultural heritage clearance from Kementerian Pendidikan dan Kebudayaan.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Performing arts — live artistic performance activities including dance, theater, music concerts, opera, puppetry, circus, and other staged performances. This covers the act of performing, not the venue (90310) or the event organization (90391). If you're on stage performing, this is your code.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:

intel_2026.whatChanged: This is a completely new code in KBLI 2025 — it didn't exist as a separate code in 2020 (BPS_ONLY status). Performing arts were previously bundled with broader entertainment or cultural activity codes. The 2025 classification gives performing arts its own dedicated code.
intel_2026.baliContext: Bali has one of the richest performing arts traditions in the world — Legong, Barong, Kecak, and Wayang puppet theater are UNESCO-recognized cultural treasures. For foreign performing artists, the opportunity lies in contemporary fusion: combining Balinese dance with modern choreography, creating international music festivals, or staging theatrical productions that draw on local mythology. The Ubud Writers & Readers Festival, BaliSpirit Festival, and various music events demonstrate the appetite for performing arts. Be mindful that traditional Balinese performing arts are deeply tied to Hindu religious ceremonies — commercial use of sacred performances requires cultural sensitivity and community consent.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Arts venues and facilities — physical spaces dedicated to displaying or hosting artistic and cultural activities. Art galleries, performance halls, exhibition spaces, cultural centers, artist studios open to the public, and creative coworking spaces focused on arts. You provide the space; artists and performers use it.

intel_2026.whatChanged: This is a completely new code in KBLI 2025 — it didn't exist as a separate code in 2020 (BPS_ONLY status). Previously, arts venues were classified under broader property or entertainment codes. The 2025 system recognizes the venue as a distinct business activity within the arts ecosystem.
intel_2026.baliContext: Bali's gallery scene is concentrated in Ubud (ARMA Museum, Neka Art Museum, Agung Rai Fine Art Gallery) but expanding into Canggu, Seminyak, and even Tabanan. The emerging model is the hybrid creative space: part gallery, part cafe, part event venue, part co-working — places like Hubud (before its closure) and Tropical Nomad showed the appetite for creative community spaces. For foreign investors, the play is contemporary art galleries targeting the international collector market, or creative hubs that host exhibitions, workshops, and events. Combine with 90391 for event programming and 85573 for training programs to create a sustainable business model that doesn't rely solely on art sales.

intel_2026.baliContext: Bali's event calendar is packed with arts and cultural events: Ubud Writers & Readers Festival, BaliSpirit Festival, Bali Arts Festival (Pesta Kesenian Bali — the island's biggest cultural event, held annually since 1979), Bali Megarupa (contemporary art), and dozens of smaller gallery openings, art walks, and creative markets. The opportunity for foreign organizers: international-standard art fairs (Bali lacks an Art Basel-type event), creative industry conferences targeting the digital nomad community, and cultural exchange festivals. Key practical consideration: event permits in Bali require police clearance (Surat Izin Keramaian), venue permits from the local kelurahan, and sometimes special permits for events near temples or sacred sites. Start permit applications at least 2-3 months in advance.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Fitness center / gym — providing physical fitness facilities and equipment for exercise and training. Covers commercial gyms, boutique fitness studios, CrossFit boxes, Pilates studios, and multi-equipment training centers. If people pay to use exercise equipment in your building, this is the code.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Kecil / Menengah / Besar scale**: Medium-Low risk (Menengah Rendah). NIB + Standard Certificate issued **automatically**. Post-issuance: Self-Assessment document, LSPr-certified tourism business standard (required for PMA), Health Feasibility Certificate (SLS).

**PMA:** Fully open (TERBUKA) — 100% foreign ownership allowed.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Direct match from KBLI 2020 (MATCH_LANGSUNG). Same code, same scope. Fitness centers have been consistently classified.
intel_2026.baliContext: Bali's fitness scene has exploded. Canggu alone has Body Factory, S2S CrossFit, Finns Recreation Club, and dozens of boutique studios. The digital nomad crowd drives demand for premium gym memberships (IDR 1-3 million/month). Uluwatu and Pererenan are the next growth zones. The business model ranges from budget gyms (high volume, low price) to premium boutique concepts (yoga-meets-gym, functional training). Equipment import is a significant upfront cost — commercial-grade gym equipment from brands like Technogym or Life Fitness carries heavy import duties. Many operators lease equipment to manage cash flow.

- 93111 — Stadium Facilities (if your facility includes outdoor sports areas)

intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Mikro / Kecil scale**: Medium-High risk (Menengah Tinggi). NIB + Standard Certificate within **14 working days**. Self-Assessment required. LSPr-certified tourism standard + Health Feasibility Certificate.

intel_2026.baliContext: Bali has established golf clubs — New Kuta Golf (Pecatu), Bali National Golf Club (Nusa Dua), Bali Handara (Bedugul), and Nirwana Bali Golf (Tanah Lot area). Land requirements are enormous (50-80 hectares minimum), making new golf course development virtually impossible in south Bali due to land scarcity and the construction moratorium. North Bali (Singaraja) is the only realistic zone for new development. Water usage is a critical concern — golf courses consume enormous quantities and face increasing regulatory scrutiny.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Theme Parks and Amusement Parks — operating permanent, location-based attractions such as mechanical rides, water parks, themed exhibitions, and picnic grounds where customers pay an entrance ticket. It explicitly excludes gambling and lottery operations.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
Two licensing tiers from aggregated PP28 sources (93219, 93211):

**Tier 1 — Menengah/Besar**: High risk (Tinggi). NIB + License (Izin) within **14 days**. Self-Assessment required. LSPr-certified Tourism Business Standard + Health Feasibility Certificate (Sertifikat Laik Sehat). Authority: Menteri/Kepala Badan. **Note:** This tier is flagged as `dati_inferiti` (inferred data) in our PP28 mapping — the licensing requirements were extrapolated from the old source codes (93219/93211), not directly published for 93210. Treat with caution and verify with OSS when KBLI 2025 is integrated.

**Tier 2 — Mikro/Kecil/Menengah/Besar**: Medium-Low risk (Menengah Rendah). NIB + Standard Certificate issued **automatically** (Otomatis). Health Feasibility Certificate required. LSPr certification for PMA companies. Self-Assessment document for theme park/amusement standards. Authority: Bupati/Walikota.

**PMA Status:** Fully open (Terbuka) — 100% foreign ownership.

**Source Regulation:** PP 28/2025 (aggregated from 93219, 93211).
intel_2026.whatChanged: MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE. Merged and cleaned up from previous KBLI 2020 codes to explicitly consolidate theme parks and water parks into one category.
intel_2026.baliContext: This is the big leagues. If you are building a water park (like Waterbom), a massive cultural park, or a large-scale beach club that operates primarily as an amusement venue with immersive attractions, 93210 is your code. The capital expenditure is astronomical, and so is the red tape. A High-Risk classification means your NIB is virtually useless until you pass rigorous Environmental Impact Assessments (AMDAL or UKL-UPL) and deal directly with Ministerial levels in Jakarta. Water rights (SIPA) for waterparks in Bali are currently highly contested due to the island's dropping water table, meaning securing extraction permits can take over a year. You must also have profound alignment with the local Desa Adat (Customary Village) regarding traffic management.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 56101 — Restaurants (for the massive F&B venues inside the park)
- 47192 — Non-Food Retail (for the inevitable gift shops and merchandise stores)
- 90200 — Performing Arts (if your theme park features live theatrical or cultural dance performances)
intel_2026.zantaraOpener: Planning a massive waterpark or themed attraction? KBLI 93210 is a High-Risk code requiring Ministerial approval and strict environmental impact studies.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Dance venue / dance floor — providing a venue primarily for dancing. Covers nightclubs (where dancing is the primary activity), dedicated dance venues, ballroom dance studios, and social dance spaces. The emphasis is on the dance activity itself, not food/drink service.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Mixed risk profile**: Medium-Low to Medium-High risk depending on scale and sub-activity. Consolidated from multiple KBLI 2020 codes. Exact requirements vary — check OSS for your specific scale.

**PMA:** Fully open (TERBUKA) — 100% foreign ownership allowed.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Consolidated from multiple KBLI 2020 codes (MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE). The aggregation brings together various dance-related entertainment codes under a single classification.
intel_2026.baliContext: Bali's nightlife scene runs deep — Seminyak (La Favela, Motel Mexicola), Kuta (Sky Garden), and increasingly Canggu. Dance venues face the highest regulatory scrutiny due to the entertainment tax (PBJT), noise ordinances, and the Governor's periodic crackdowns on late-night entertainment. The entertainment tax can be 40-75% on top of your revenue — this is not a typo, it's the most punishing tax category in Bali. Hours of operation are regulated and enforced. Banjar relations are critical — noise complaints from neighbors can shut you down faster than any government agency.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 56301 — Bar (alcohol service is almost always part of the model)
- 56101 — Restaurant (if serving food)
- 90001 — Performing Arts (if hosting live DJ/music performances)
- 93292 — Karaoke (if including karaoke rooms)
intel_2026.zantaraOpener: Opening a nightclub or dance venue in Bali? 93291 is the code — but the entertainment tax and noise regulations are the real challenge.

Many natural sites are managed by village cooperatives (Desa Adat), so partnership agreements with the local community are non-negotiable. intel_2026.whatItMeans: Beach tourism — providing facilities for enjoying beach beauty. This covers renting out beach chairs and umbrellas, managing basic beach facilities, and beach area management. If you're running a business that monetizes access to or enjoyment of a beach area, this is the code.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Risk: Menengah Tinggi (Medium-High)** across all scales. NIB + Sertifikat Standar required, 14-day issuance at Governor level. Must complete self-assessment (Penilaian Mandiri). Post-issuance: obtain Sertifikat Standar Usaha Pariwisata from LSPr and Sertifikat Laik Sehat (SLS). Maritime permit (Surat Izin Wisata Bahari) needed if operating on the sea for 30+ days.

**PMA:** Fully open (TERBUKA), 100% foreign ownership allowed. Zoning is critical: OSS will auto-reject if your location isn't zoned for beach exploitation.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Aggregated from KBLI 2020 codes (MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE) — combines 93295 with PP28 code 93245.
intel_2026.baliContext: This is CRITICAL for beach clubs — and here's where it gets complicated. A 'beach club' in Bali typically needs MULTIPLE KBLI codes: 56101 (restaurant), 56301 (bar), 93295 (beach area), and potentially 90xxx codes for entertainment. You can't just pick one. The Sempadan Pantai (100-meter setback line from high tide) is strictly enforced, and Bali's coastal zoning regulations add another layer. Many beach clubs in Seminyak and Canggu have faced enforcement actions for building too close to the waterline. OSS auto-rejects if the location isn't zoned for beach exploitation — check your RDTR (spatial plan) first.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 56101 — If serving food (restaurant license)
- 56301 — If serving alcohol (bar license)
- 93297 — If offering water sports activities
- 93191 — If operating a sports/recreation venue on the beach

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Agro tourism — providing tourism experiences centered on agriculture, farming, and food production. Covers coffee plantation tours, rice terrace walks, organic farm visits, spice garden tours, and agricultural education experiences.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Mixed risk profile**: Medium-High risk (Menengah Tinggi) across most scales. Consolidated from multiple KBLI 2020 codes. NIB + Standard Certificate required.

**Menengah / Besar scale**: Medium-High (Menengah Tinggi). LSPr certification and Health Certificate required.

**PMA:** Fully open (TERBUKA) — 100% foreign ownership allowed.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Consolidated from multiple KBLI 2020 codes (MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE). Agro tourism is now explicitly recognized as a distinct tourism category.
intel_2026.baliContext: Agro tourism is deeply embedded in Bali's appeal — luwak coffee plantation visits (Tegallalang/Kintamani), Jatiluwih rice terrace walks (UNESCO World Heritage), chocolate factory tours (Jasmine Kitchen near Sanur), and the growing organic farm-to-table movement. The PMA model that works best: lease agricultural land, develop a visitor experience (guided tours, workshops, tastings), and integrate with F&B (on-site cafe serving farm produce). Tegallalang and Ubud are the most established areas. The medium-high risk classification reflects the dual nature of the business — you're managing both an agricultural operation and a tourism destination. Subak (traditional irrigation) cooperatives control water access for rice operations and must be consulted.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 56101 — Restaurant (farm-to-table dining component)
- 79121 — Tour Operator (if packaging as tourism products)
- 93294 — Nature Adventure (if combining with outdoor activities)
- 01191 — Organic Farming (if also selling agricultural products)
intel_2026.zantaraOpener: Agro tourism in Bali — coffee plantations, rice terraces, farm experiences? 93296 now consolidates the old codes. Let me walk through the licensing.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Water tourism (Tirta) — water-based tourism activities including rafting, snorkeling, diving operations, water sports, river tourism, and lake recreation. If your business puts tourists on, in, or under water for fun, this is the code.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Risk: Rendah (Low)** for Small/Medium/Large scales. Only NIB required, automatic issuance. Separate safety certifications required for each water activity type. Insurance for participants is mandatory.

**PMA:** Fully open (TERBUKA), 100% foreign ownership allowed.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Renumbered code (CODICE_RINUMERATO) — was 93246 in KBLI 2020, now 93297 in 2025. Scope expanded to explicitly include rafting, diving, snorkeling, free diving, sea walker, marina activities, surfing, jet ski, parasailing, and submarine experiences.
intel_2026.baliContext: Bali's water tourism is massive — diving in Tulamben, Amed, and Nusa Penida; rafting on the Ayung River; water sports in Tanjung Benoa. Each activity type has its own safety certification requirements on top of the KBLI licensing. Dive operators need PADI/SSI shop certification and specific insurance. Rafting operators need river safety certifications. The insurance requirement isn't optional — if someone gets hurt without coverage, you're looking at criminal liability, not just civil. Pro tip: partner with established operators while building your reputation rather than going solo from day one.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 93295 — If also managing a beach area
- 93111 — If operating a sports facility alongside
- 79121 — If packaging water activities as part of tour packages
- 56101 — If serving food at your water tourism base

intel_2026.whatYouNeed:

intel_2026.baliContext: Bali's tourism-driven economy creates appetite for new entertainment concepts — escape rooms in Seminyak and Canggu, axe throwing bars, virtual reality arcades, and novelty entertainment venues are growing. The family tourism segment (particularly in Kuta and Nusa Dua) supports entertainment venues. Dinas Pariwisata (Tourism Office) approval is required alongside OSS licensing for entertainment businesses. Noise ordinances in residential areas and adat village restrictions on commercial entertainment apply especially in Ubud and Canggu.

data.judul: JASA INTERMEDIASI REPARASI DAN PERAWATAN KOMPUTER,
data.uraian:
BARANG PRIBADI DAN RUMAH TANGGA, MOBIL, SERTA SEPEDA
MOTOR
Kelompok ini mencakup jasa intermediasi dalam reparasi dan
perawatan komputer, barang pribadi dan rumah tangga, mobil, dan
sepeda motor dengan cara mempertemukan pihak pengguna dan
penyedia jasa berdasarkan imbalan atau komisi, tanpa intermediator
menyediakan jasa yang diintermediasikan. Kegiatan intermediasi
dapat dilakukan melalui platform digital atau melalui kanal nondigital
(tatap muka, termasuk door -to-door; telepon; surat; dan lainnya).
Imbalan atau komisi dapat diterima dari pihak pengguna atau
penyedia jasa reparasi. Pendapatan dari kegiatan intermediasi juga
dapat mencakup sumber lain, seperti pendapatan dari iklan.
