intel_2026.whatItMeans: Washing and Dry Cleaning of Textiles and Fur — covers commercial laundry, dry cleaning, ironing, carpet cleaning, curtain cleaning, and uniform/linen rental services. It applies to services operated mechanically, by hand, or coin-operated, for both the general public and industrial/commercial clients. It explicitly excludes clothing alterations.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
This code aggregated 5 old PP28 sources (96112, 96121, 96129, 96122, 96111), creating a **complex multi-tier risk structure** where risk depends on BOTH scale AND sub-activity type:

**Tier 1 — General commercial laundry (Mikro/Kecil/Menengah)**: Low risk (Rendah). NIB only, **automatic**. Report to Minister of Trade. Authority: Gubernur Daerah Khusus Jakarta (outside Jakarta: Bupati/Walikota).

**Tier 2 — Tourism-integrated laundry (Mikro/Kecil/Menengah)**: Medium-Low risk (Menengah Rendah). NIB only, **automatic**. Periodic activity reports. Authority: Bupati/Walikota.

**Tier 3 — Full-service with tourism standards (Mikro/Kecil/Menengah/Besar)**: Medium-Low risk (Menengah Rendah). NIB + Standard Certificate, **automatic**. Self-Assessment document. Health Feasibility Certificate (SLS). LSPr-certified tourism standard (required for PMA). Authority: Bupati/Walikota.

**Tier 4 — Higher-complexity operations (Mikro/Kecil/Menengah)**: Medium-High risk (Menengah Tinggi). NIB + Standard Certificate within **14 days**. Self-Assessment required. LSPr certification + Health Certificate. Authority: Gubernur.

**Tier 5 — Large-scale industrial/clinical (Besar)**: High risk (Tinggi). NIB + Izin. Medical staff competence certificates required (Sertifikat kompetensi tenaga medis) — this applies to hospital linen and clinical bio-waste handling. Authority: Menteri/Kepala Badan. **No fictitious positive** — approval must be explicitly granted.

**PMA Status:** Fully open (Terbuka) — 100% foreign ownership.

**Source Regulation:** PP 28/2025 (aggregated from old codes 96111, 96112, 96121, 96122, 96129).
intel_2026.whatChanged: MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE. Consolidated from multiple fragmented cleaning codes in the previous system into a single comprehensive textile cleaning category.
intel_2026.baliContext: Commercial laundry is one of the most stable, unglamorous, yet highly profitable B2B businesses in Bali. Every villa, hotel, and spa needs reliable daily linen turnaround. However, operating a large-scale laundry PT PMA faces one massive, existential hurdle: water. You cannot simply dump chemical detergent wastewater into the local subak (irrigation) system. Villages (Banjars) and the Environmental Agency (DLHK) will shut you down immediately. You must invest heavily in a proper Wastewater Treatment Plant (IPAL) and secure a Groundwater Extraction Permit (SIPA). Finding industrial-zoned land away from tourist centers (like in Denpasar or Tabanan) is the smartest play to keep costs down.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 49231 — Road Freight Transport (if you are operating a fleet of vans for pickup and delivery)
- 46411 — Wholesale of Textiles (if you also sell wholesale linens to the hotels you service)
- 95291 — Clothing Repair (if you offer uniform alterations alongside dry cleaning)
intel_2026.zantaraOpener: Commercial laundry is a B2B goldmine in Bali's hospitality sector, but under KBLI 96100, your biggest hurdle will be strict wastewater compliance.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Hair salon and barbershop — cutting, styling, coloring, perming, straightening, and general hair care services for men and women. This covers traditional barbershops, modern salons, blowout bars, and specialized hair treatment studios. If people come in and leave with different hair, this is the code.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Mikro / Kecil / Menengah scale**: Low risk (Rendah). NIB only, **automatic** issuance. No additional licenses or permits required at these scales.

**PMA:** Fully open (TERBUKA) — 100% foreign ownership allowed.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Direct match from KBLI 2020 (MATCH_LANGSUNG). Same code, same scope. Hair salons have been consistently classified across both KBLI versions.
intel_2026.baliContext: Bali's expat areas — Canggu, Seminyak, Ubud — are packed with premium salons targeting the international crowd. Many charge Jakarta-level prices (IDR 300-800k for a cut and style). Korean and Japanese hair concepts are popular. The competition is fierce in the southern tourist belt, but areas like Sanur and Denpasar still have room for quality-focused operators. Low risk classification makes this one of the simplest codes to get started with. Most foreign-owned salons in Bali operate with Indonesian stylists and a foreign owner-director handling branding and customer experience.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 96220 — Beauty Care (if also offering nail services, facials, makeup)
- 96230 — Spa/Sauna (if incorporating wellness treatments)
- 47725 — Retail of Cosmetics/Beauty Products (if selling hair care products)
intel_2026.zantaraOpener: Opening a salon or barbershop in Bali? 96210 is low risk and fully PMA-open — one of the simplest codes to work with.

KECANTIKAN LAINNYA
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan perawatan kecantikan yang tidak
dilakukan oleh dokter spesialis, misalnya oleh ahli kosmetik.
Kelompok ini mencakup
- layanan kecantikan yang utamanya untuk perwatan dan
mempercantik kuku di nail studio/datang ke rumah, seperti nail
art dan manikur-pedikur.
- layanan kecantikan yang utamanya untuk perwatan dan
mempercantik bulu mata di eyelash studio/datang ke rumah
seperti eyelash extension, lash lift, lash pirming, dan lash tint;
- layanan kecantikan yang utamanya untuk perawatan dan
mempercantik alis di brow studio/datang ke rumah seperti sulam
alis, brow bomber, dan brow lamination;
- layanan kecantikan yang utamanya untuk penghilangan bulu di
wax studio/datang ke rumah;
- layanan rias wajah oleh penata rias/make-up artist (MUA);
- layanan pijat wajah;
- layanan penyamakan kulit.
Kelompok ini tidak mencakup
- kegiatan bedah plastik/operasi yang dilakukan oleh dokter

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Beauty care and treatments — services performed by cosmeticians (not doctors). Nail studios, manicures, pedicures, nail art, facials, body treatments, lash extensions, makeup services, and beauty care delivered at the client's home. This is non-medical aesthetics and beauty treatments.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Brand new code (BPS_ONLY)** — no PP28/2025 licensing data exists yet. The specific risk category, requirements, and licensing pathway haven't been published. Get your NIB and monitor OSS for updates.

**PMA:** Fully open — 100% foreign ownership.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Completely new code in KBLI 2025 — didn't exist before (BPS_ONLY). In 2020, beauty care activities were lumped into broader personal service codes. The 2025 classification breaks them out explicitly, recognizing the beauty industry as a distinct sector. This is a big deal for the industry — finally having a specific code makes licensing clearer.
intel_2026.baliContext: Bali's beauty and wellness industry is massive. Seminyak and Canggu are packed with nail salons, beauty studios, and aesthetic clinics. The distinction between 96220 (beauty care, non-medical) and medical aesthetics is important — Botox, fillers, and laser treatments need medical codes, not this one. Many Bali beauty businesses are run by Indonesians with foreign investment, especially Korean and Japanese beauty concepts. Since this is a brand-new code with no PP28 data yet, the licensing situation is in flux. Get your NIB and prepare for when specific requirements are published.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 96230 — If you also offer spa/sauna services
- 96210 — If you also do hair cutting/styling
- 47725 — If you retail beauty products
intel_2026.zantaraOpener: Opening a beauty studio or nail salon in Bali? 96220 is a brand-new 2025 code — here's what we know about licensing so far.

data.judul: AKTIVITAS SANTE PAR AQUA (SPA) HARIAN, SAUNA, DAN
data.uraian:
PEMANDIAN UAP
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan yang menyediakan pelayanan
kebugaran dan perawatan dengan memadukan metode tradisional
dan modern secara holistik. Aktivitas ini menggunakan air dan
pendukung perawatan lainnya berupa pijat menggunakan ramuan,
terapi aroma, latihan fisik, terapi warna, terapi musik, makanan dan
minuman. Tujuan aktivitas ini menyeimbangkan antara tubuh (body),
pikiran (mind), dan jiwa (soul), sehingga terwujud kondisi relaks dan
bugar untuk kesehatan yang optimal. Aktivitas ini juga merupakan
upaya mempertahankan tradisi dan budaya bangsa.
Kelompok ini mencakup
- aktivitas pemandian Turki, sauna, dan pemandian uap, spa
harian, solarium, salon pelangsing dan pengecilan tubuh, dan
lainnya.
Subgolongan tidak mencakup
- layanan kesejahteraan fisik sebagai bagian dari aktivitas
akomodasi, lihat golongan pokok 55l
- aktivitas terapis pijat medis, lihat subgolongan 8699;
- aktivitas praktisioner di bidang shiatsu, pijat Thailand, watsu,
tuina qigong, lihat subgolongan 8699;
- aktivitas klub dan fasilitas kesehatan, kebugaran, dan
pembentukan tubuh, lihat subgolongan 9311.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Day spas, saunas, and steam baths — wellness facilities that provide holistic body care combining traditional and modern methods. Water-based treatments, massage with herbal preparations, aromatherapy, physical exercises, color therapy, music therapy, and physical fitness activities. This is the Bali spa experience in a code.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Brand new code (BPS_ONLY)** — no PP28/2025 licensing data published yet. Risk category and specific requirements are pending. NIB required at minimum.

**PMA:** Fully open — 100% foreign ownership.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Brand new in KBLI 2025 (BPS_ONLY). In KBLI 2020, spa activities were covered under broader wellness/personal care codes. The 2025 classification recognizes spa specifically. Given Indonesia's (and especially Bali's) spa industry prominence, this dedicated code was overdue.
intel_2026.baliContext: Bali is globally famous for spas. From high-end resort spas in Nusa Dua to IDR 100k massage places in Kuta, the spa industry is a tourism pillar. The 2025 code 96230 finally gives spas their own classification. Since it's BPS_ONLY (no PP28 licensing data yet), the detailed requirements are pending. However, existing spa operations in Bali typically need: Tanda Daftar Usaha Pariwisata (TDUP), health and hygiene certification, trained therapists with competency certificates, and compliance with spa standards (SNI). Ubud and Seminyak command the highest prices. Day spas versus hotel spas have very different business models — day spas are more accessible for smaller investors.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 96220 — If you also offer beauty treatments
- 96210 — If you also do hair services
- 55203 or 55101 — If the spa is part of a villa/hotel
- 56303 — If you serve drinks (herbal teas, juices) as part of the spa experience
intel_2026.zantaraOpener: Opening a spa in Bali? 96230 is a brand-new dedicated code for 2025 — here's the current licensing situation and what to prepare for.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Funeral and related services — managing funerals, cremations, burial preparation, and associated logistics. Covers funeral homes, cremation services, body preparation, cemetery management, and memorial services. A niche but essential service sector.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**BPS_ONLY** — no PP28/2025 licensing data exists yet. Risk category and specific requirements haven't been published. Get your NIB and monitor OSS for updates.

**PMA:** Fully open (TERBUKA) — 100% foreign ownership allowed.
intel_2026.whatChanged: BPS_ONLY — this code exists in the BPS classification but has no corresponding PP28/2025 licensing data yet. Funeral services have historically been community-managed in Indonesia, and the commercial classification is still catching up.
intel_2026.baliContext: Funeral services in Bali are deeply tied to Hindu religious traditions — the Ngaben (cremation) ceremony is one of the most important cultural practices. Commercial funeral services for the local Balinese population are virtually non-existent as a PMA opportunity; these are managed through Banjar and family structures. The realistic PMA angle is serving the international community: expat memorial services, repatriation logistics for deceased foreigners, and potentially pet cremation services (growing niche). Denpasar has a small number of commercial funeral service providers, mostly serving non-Hindu communities.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 52299 — Freight Forwarding (if handling international repatriation of remains)
- 96900 — Other Personal Services (for adjacent memorial/remembrance services)
intel_2026.zantaraOpener: Funeral services in Bali is a niche market with deep cultural sensitivities. 96300 has no PP28 data yet — let me explain the landscape.

data.judul: AKTIVITAS JASA INTERMEDIASI UNTUK JASA PERORANGAN
data.uraian:
Kelompok ini mencakup jasa intermediasi jasa perorangan yang
mempertemukan klien dan penyedia layanan dengan biaya atau
komisi, tanpa intermediator yang menyediakan layanan yang
diintermediasikan. Kegiatan intermediasi ini dapat dilakukan melalui
platform digital maupun melalui saluran nondigital (tatap muka,
termasuk door -to-door; telepon; surat). Imbalan atau komisi dapat
diterima baik dari klien maupun penyedia layanan pribadi.
Pendapatan dari kegiatan intermediasi dapat mencakup sumber
pendapatan lain, seperti pendapatan dari iklan. Kelompok ini juga
mencakup kegiatan agen penatu dan dry cleaning.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Personal services intermediary — a platform that connects clients with personal service providers. Spa/massage bookings, beauty service aggregators, personal service matching platforms. You're the matchmaker between the person who wants a service and the person who provides it.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**BPS_ONLY** — no PP28/2025 licensing data exists yet. This is a newer concept reflecting the platform economy.

**PMA:** No specific Kepmen 228 category — KEDUA-only. Foreign owners can hold Director/Commissioner positions but no sector-specific TKA positions are listed.
intel_2026.whatChanged: New in KBLI 2025 — refined intermediary definition for the personal services sector. The platform economy is finally getting its own classification rather than being shoehorned into generic IT or service codes.
intel_2026.baliContext: The platform economy for beauty and wellness services is growing fast in Bali. Think apps that let you book a massage therapist to your villa, or platforms aggregating spa services across Ubud. Critical tax issue to be aware of: 'Spa' classified as entertainment can face 40-75% PBJT (entertainment tax). You must clarify whether your platform connects users with 'wellness/health' services (lower tax bracket) or 'entertainment/spa' services (higher tax bracket). The classification makes a massive difference to your margins and your service providers' pricing.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 96100 — If also operating a hair salon directly
- 96210 — If also providing beauty treatments directly
- 96900 — If your platform covers other personal services
- 62110 — If you're also developing the platform software in-house
intel_2026.zantaraOpener: Building a platform for personal services in Bali? 96400 covers the intermediary model — but watch out for the entertainment tax classification trap.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Other personal services — the catch-all for personal services that don't fit elsewhere. This covers personal household services (cooking, cleaning, ironing), pet care, astrology, fortune telling, and specialized retreat services. If it's a personal service and there's no better code for it, it lands here.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Risk: Rendah (Low)** across all scales. Only NIB required, automatic issuance. As a catch-all code, specific requirements will depend heavily on what you're actually doing under this umbrella.

**PMA:** Fully open (TERBUKA), 100% foreign ownership allowed. KEDUA-only for TKA — no specific Kepmen 228 category. Director/Commissioner positions only for foreign workers.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Aggregated from KBLI 2020 codes (MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE) — combines 96900 with PP28 codes 96990 and 96910.
intel_2026.baliContext: This is where Bali's niche retreat economy lives. Sound healing sessions, breathwork workshops, plant medicine ceremonies (legally grey area — tread carefully), personal concierge services for villa guests, pet sitting and grooming for expat pets — all potentially under 96900. The vagueness of 'other personal services' can be both a blessing and a curse: it gives you flexibility, but it also means regulators have discretion in how they interpret your activities. If your service could reasonably fit under a more specific code, use that specific code instead.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 96400 — If operating a platform connecting service providers
- 96100 — If also doing hair care services
- 86993 — If your retreat services overlap with traditional medicine
- 96210 — If offering beauty treatments alongside
intel_2026.zantaraOpener: Running a niche personal service in Bali that doesn't fit standard categories? 96900 is the catch-all — but make sure a more specific code doesn't apply first.

data.judul: AKTIVITAS RUMAH TANGGA SEBAGAI PEMBERI KERJA BAGI
data.uraian:
PEKERJA RUMAH TANGGA (PRT)
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan rumah tangga sebagai pemberi kerja
pekerja rumah tangga (PRT), seperti asisten rumah tangga, juru
masak, juru bersih, tukang kebun, sopir pribadi, penjaga rumah,
pengasuh anak, asisten pribadi, termasuk guru apabila menjadi
pekerja dari rumah tangga.
Kelompok ini memungkinkan pekerja rumah tangga (PRT) untuk
menyebutkan kegiatan pemberi kerjanya dalam sensus atau
penelitian, meskipun pemberi kerja tersebut adalah perorangan atau
rumah tangga. Produk yang dihasilkan dari kegiatan ini dikonsumsi
oleh rumah tangga pemberi kerja.
Kelompok ini tidak mencakup penyediaan jasa perorangan dan rumah

data.judul: AKTIVITAS PRODUKSI BARANG OLEH RUMAH TANGGA UNTUK
data.uraian:
KEPERLUAN SENDIRI
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan menghasilkan barang pokok rumah
tangga yang sejenis, dengan kata lain kegiatan rumah tangga tersebut
digunakan dalam berbagai macam kegiatan yang menghasilkan
barang untuk kebutuhan mereka sendiri.
Kegiatan ini mencakup perburuan dan pengumpulan, pertanian,
pengadaan tempat berlindung dan pakaian dan barang lain yang
diproduksi oleh rumah tangga untuk kebutuhannya. Dalam
praktiknya, jika rumah tangga juga diikutsertakan dalam produksi
barang yang dip asarkan, maka digolongkan ke dalam industri
penghasil barang yang sesuai dengan KBLI.
Jika utamanya digunakan dalam kegiatan produksi barang pokok
khusus, maka diklasifikasikan ke dalam industri produksi barang
yang sesuai dari KBLI.

data.judul: AKTIVITAS PRODUKSI BERAGAM JASA OLEH RUMAH TANGGA
data.uraian:
UNTUK KEPERLUAN SENDIRI
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan rumah tangga dalam menghasilkan
jasa pokok, seperti memasak, mengajar atau mendidik, merawat atau
menjaga anggota rumah tangga dan jasa lain yang dihasilkan oleh
rumah tangga untuk kebutuhannya sendiri.
Dalam praktiknya, jika rumah tangga tersebut juga terkait dalam
memproduksi berbagai macam jasa untuk memenuhi kebutuhan
sendiri, maka diklasifikasikan dalam kegiatan rumah tangga yang
menghasilkan jasa untuk memenuhi kebutuhan sendiri.
